verses.text: Mose umusavyi w’ Uhoraho amaze gupfa, Uhoraho yabariye Yosuwa mwene Nuni, uwahora afasha Mose ibikorwa ati:
“Umusavyi wanje Mose yapfuye. None rero mwe n’aba bantu mwese nimwitegure, mujabuke uruzi Yorodani, muje mu gihugu mpaye Abisirayeli.
Aho muzohonyoza ikirenge hose ndahabahaye nk’uko nabisezeraniye Mose.
Igihugu canyu kizotangurira ku bugaragwa bw’i Libani no ku ruzi runini ari rwo Efurate, harimwo n’intara y’Abaheti, gushika ku Kiyaga Mediterane, mu burengero.
Nta wuzoshobora kuguhangara ngo akugwanye igihe cose ushigaje kubaho. Nk’uko nabanye na Mose, ni ko nzobana nawe. Sinzokureka wenyene, sinzoguhemukira.
Komera kandi shira ubwoba, kuko ari wewe uzojana aba bantu kugira ngo begukire igihugu nasezeraniye ba sekuruza nkabarahira ko nzokibaha.
Komere wongere ushire ubwoba. Witwararike kwumvira ivyagezwe vyose umusavyi wanje Mose yaguhaye; ntuzohengamire i buryo canke i bubamfu, ni ho uzoshobora kwama ushika ku ntumbero yawe aho uzoja hose.

Amajambo ari muri iki Gitabu c’Ivyagezwe ntaze yigere ava mu kanwa kawe. Uze wame uyiyumvirako ku murango no mw’ijoro, kugira ngo uzoshobore kwumvira ivyanditsemwo vyose. Ni ho uzoshobora kwama uja imbere, ugashika ku ntumbero mu vyo uzokora vyose.
None si jewe ndakwibaririye nti: Komera ushire ubwoba? Ntutinye, ntucike intege, kuko jewe Uhoraho Imana yawe nzojana nawe aho uzoja hose.”
Nuko Yosuwa aca ategeka abatware b’Abisirayeli ati:

“Nimunyurangane muce mu mihana, mubwire abantu muti: ‘Nimutegure ivyo muzofungura mu rugendo. Kuko mu misi itatu tuzojabuka uruzi Yorodani, kugira ngo twinjire igihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye ngo mucegukire.’ ”
Ariko Yosuwa abarira abo mu miryango ya Reyubeni na Gadi hamwe n’igice c’umuryango wa Manase ati:
“Mwibuke itegeko Mose umusavyi w’Imana yabahaye. Yababwiye ati: ‘ Uhoraho abahaye akaruhuko, abahaye iki gihugu.’

Abagore banyu, abana banyu n’ibitungwa vyanyu birashobora gusigara muri iki gihugu Mose yabahaye co mu buseruko bwa Yorodani, ariko abagabo bashobora kuja mu ntambara bafate ibigwanisho, bajabuke imbere ya benewabo. Mutegerezwa kubafasha,

gushika Uhoraho abahaye uburuhukiro nk’uko namwe yabubahaye, bagafata igihugu cose Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye. Inyuma y’aho, muzoheza mugaruke mube mu gihugu canyu, ico Mose umusavyi w’ Uhoraho yabahaye mu buseruko bwa Yorodani, uravye iyo izuba riserukira.”
Maze bishura Yosuwa bati: “Ivyo udutegeka vyose tuzobikora, kandi aho uzoturungika hose tuzojayo.
Nk’uko twumvira Mose, ni ko na wewe tuzokwumvira. Ariko rero, Uhoraho Imana yawe azobane nawe nk’uko yabana na Mose.
Uwuzogarariza amategeko yawe ntakore ivyo uvuze azokwicwa. Ariko ukomere ushire ubwoba!”

Maze Yosuwa mwene Nuni arungika abatasi babiri mu mpisho, bava i Shitimu aho Abisirayeli bari bashinze amahema. Abawira ati: “Genda murondere amakuru y’ingene ico gihugu kimeze, na canecane i Yeriko.” Nuko baragenda binjira mu nzu kwa maraya yitwa Rahabu, basabaho indaro.
Ariko umwami w’i Yeriko aca aramenya ko hariho abantu b’Abisirayeli baje muri iryo joro gutata ico gihugu.
Aca arungika intumwa kuri Rahabu ati: “Zana abo bantu baje aho mu nzu iwawe, kuko baje gutata igihugu cacu cose.”
Ariko Rahabu yari yabanyegeje. Aca ababwira ati: “Ni vyo abo bantu baje iwanje, ariko sinamenye iyo baje bava.
Ku mugoroba, hageze kwugara amarembo y’igisagara, baciye bagenda, kandi sinzi inzira bajanye. Ihute mubakurikire, kumbure mwobafata.”
Ariko yari yabanyegeje hejuru ku nzu, abapfuka ibiti bivamwo inyuzi yari yahanikiye.
Ba bantu baca bafata ibarabara rija ku ruzi Yorodani ngo baje kubaronderayo. Bamaze gusohoka, irembo rica rirugarwa.
Mw’ijoro, imbere y’uko abo batasi baryama, Rahabu aduga hejuru ku nzu aho bari
ababwira ati: “Ndazi ko Uhoraho Imana yanyu yabahaye iki gihugu, kandi ubwoba bwadutekeye, abantu bose imitima yabo yarandutse kubera ubwoba mwaduteye.

Twarumvise ko Uhoraho yakamije Ikiyaga Gitukura ku bwanyu igihe mwariko murava muri Egiputa, turumva n’ivyo mwagiriye Sihoni na Ogi, abami babiri b’Abamori, bo mu buseruko bwa Yorodani, abo mwaranduye rwose.
Tuvyumvise, imitima yacu yacitse ivutu kubera ubwoba, kandi umuntu wese aca arihebura kubera mwebwe, kuko Uhoraho ari we Mana iganje hejuru mw’ijuru no hasi, kw’isi.
None rero, nimundahire mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho ko muzogirira neza umuryango wanje, kuko ndabagiriye neza. Mumpe ikimenyetso c’ukuri
ko muzokingira ubuzima bwa data n’ubwa mama, n’ubw’abo tuvukana hamwe n’ivyanje vyose, ko muzotuzigama ntidupfe.”
Ba batasi baramusezeranira bati: “Tukurahiye ubuzima bwacu nyene! Nutavuga ivyo turiko turakora hano, natwe tuzoba abizigirwa kandi tuzokugirira neza, igihe Uhoraho azoba aduhaye iki gihugu.”
Nuko, aca abururutsa ku mugozi abacishije mw’idirisha, kuko inzu yiwe yari ifatanye n’uruhome rugize uruzitiro rw’igisagara.
Aca ababwira ati: “Nimugende, muce mu mitumba kugira ngo ababakurikiye ntibababone. Mwinyegezeyo imisi itatu gushika bagarutse, muzoheze mubandanye urugendo rwanyu.”
Abo bagabo na bo baramubwira bati: “Indahiro twakurahiye ntizodukurikirana

nitwinjira muri iki gihugu, ntidusange aka kanyuzi gatukura kw’idirisha watwururukirijeko canke nitutasanga wegeranirije umuryango wawe wose muri iyi nzu: so na nyoko, abo muvukana n’umuryango wawe wose.
Nihagira uwusohoka akava mu nzu yawe, akaja mw’ibarabara, amaraso yiwe ntazoja ku mitwe yacu, si twebwe tuzoyabazwa. Ariko hagize uwugira ico aba ari mu nzu yawe, amaraso yiwe azoduharurweko.
Kandi niwaramuka uvuze ivyo turiko turakora, indahiro waturahije ntizodufata.”
Rahabu na we arabishura ati: “Bibe nk’uko mubivuze.” Nuko, arabarungika bafata akayira. Aca afata ka kanyuzi gatukura, akabohera kw’idirisha.
Ba batasi baca bafata inzira ija mu mitumba bamarayo imisi itatu gushika aho bamwe bariko barabakurikira bagarutse, babarondeye hose bakababura.
Ba batasi babiri baca baramanuka bava mu mitumba, bajabuka Yorodani, maze bashitse biganira Yosuwa mwene Nuni ivyabashikiye.
Bamubwira bati: “Ni ukuri Uhoraho yaduhaye kirya gihugu. Abantu baho bose barihebuye kubera kudutinya.”
Hakiri kare mu gitondo, Yosuwa n’Abisirayeli barahaguruka bava i Shitimu baja kuri Yorodani, bashingaho amahema imbere yo kujabuka.
Haheze imisi itatu, abatware banyuragira muri mahema babamwo,
babwira abantu bati: “Nimwabona Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, mukabona n’abaherezi ari bo Balewi bayireruye, bagiye, namwe muce muva aho muri muyikurikire.
Kubera iyi nzira mutari bwayicemwo, bazobarongora, babaje imbere. Ariko mugendere nko ku ngero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi bibiri inyuma yabo, ntimuze muyegere.”
Yosuwa abarira abantu ati: “Mwiyeze kuko ejo Uhoraho azokora ibitangaza bikomeye muri mwebwe.”
Yosuwa yongera abarira abaherezi ati: “Fata Isandugu y’Isezerano muje imbere y’abandi mu kujabuka.” Nuko baterura iyo Sandugu, baja imbere baragenda.
Uhoraho abarira Yosuwa ati: “Uyu musi ngira ntangure kugushira hejuru imbere y’Abisirayeli, kugira ngo bamenye ko ndi kumwe nawe nk’uko nari kumwe na Mose.
Barira abaherezi bareruye Isandugu y’Isezerano uti: ‘Nimwashika ku nkengera y’uruzi Yorodani, muce murutambukiramwo muruhagararemwo.’ ”
Yosuwa abwira Abisirayeli ati: “Egera hino mwumvirize amajambo y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Iki ni co kizobamenyesha ko Imana nzima iri muri mwebwe, kandi ko izokwirukana imbere yanyu Abanyakanani, Abaheti, Abahiwi, Abaperizi, Abagirugashi, Abamori n’Abayebusi.
Raba Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho nyene isi yose igiye kuri Yorodani imbere yanyu.
None rero, nimutoranye abagabo icumi na babiri mu miryango y’Abisirayeli, umwumwe mu muryango.
Abaherezi bareruye Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho nyene isi yose nibamara guhonyoza ibirenge muri Yorodani, ruzocikamwo kabiri, amazi ntasubire gutemba, ahagarare nk’uruhome.”
Nuko abantu bose bamaze kuzinga amahema yabo kugira ngo bajabuke Yorodani, abaherezi baca barerura Isandugu y’Isezerano, babaja imbere.
Ico gihe hari mu gihe c’iyimbura, kandi Yorodani rwari rwarengeye inkombe zarwo. Ariko ba baherezi bari bareruye Isandugu y’Isezerano bamaze guhonyoza ibirenge mu mazi yo ku nkengera y’urwo ruzi,

amazi yo haruguru aca arahagarara ntiyasubira gutemba. Yiyegeraniriza hamwe kure y’aho bari, mu gisagara ca Adamu, hafi y’i Zaretani, ayo hepfo na yo abandanya amanuka aja mu kiyaga ca Araba, ari co Kiyaga c’Umunyu gushika akamye. Nuko abantu baca barajabuka hakurya bashika ahegereye Yeriko.

Ico gihe abaherezi bari bareruye Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho bari bahagaze bemye kw’isi yumye hagati muri Yorodani, Abisirayeli na bo bariko barajabuka gushika ihanga ryose rijabutse rica kw’isi yumutse.
Abagize iryo hanga bose bahejeje kujabuka Yorodani, Uhoraho abarira Yosuwa ati:
“Toranya abagabo icumi na babiri, umwumwe mu muryango,
ubabwire batore amabuye icumi n’abiri muri Yorodani aho abaherezi bari bahagaze, bagende bayajanye, baje kuyarunda aho muja kurara ijoro ry’uno musi.”
Nuko Yosuwa akoranya abagabo icumi na babiri bo mu Bisirayeli, umwe mu muryango,

ababwira ati: “Nimugende hagati muri Yorodani, imbere y’Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu. Umwe wese atore ibuye, aritware ku rutugu. Mutware amabuye icumi n’abiri nk’uko imiryango ya Isirayeli ingana,
tuzoyakoreshe mu kwubaka icibutso. Mu myaka iri imbere, abana banyu nibababaza bati: ‘Mbega aya mabuye asigura iki?’
muzobishure muti: Atwibutsa ko uruzi Yorodani rwigeze guhagarara igihe Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho yariko irajabuka. Ayo mabuye ni ayo kubera icibutso ubwoko bw’Abisirayeli ibihe vyose.”

Nuko Abisirayeli babikora uko Yosuwa yabibategetse. Batora amabuye icumi n’abiri hagati muri Yorodani, nk’uko imiryango ya Isirayeli iri, kandi nk’uko Uhoraho yabibwiye Yosuwa. Batwara ayo mabuye aho baraye ijoro ryabo rya mbere, bahubaka icibutso.
Yosuwa na we ashinga ayandi mabuye icumi n’abiri hagati muri Yorodani aho ba baherezi bari bareruye Isandugu y’Isezerano bari bahagaze. Ayo mabuye aracari ngaho gushika n’ubu.
Abaherezi bari bareruye Isandugu bagumye bahagaze hagati muri Yorodani gushika ivyo Uhoraho yategetse Yosuwa vyose bikozwe nk’uko Mose yari yarabibwiye Yosuwa. Maze abantu barihuta kujabuka
kandi ubwo nyene bose bahejeje kujabuka bagashika hakurya, Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho n’abaherezi bayireruye na bo baca barajabuka abantu bose babitegereza.
Abo mu muryango wa Reyubeni n’uwa Gadi, n’igice kimwe c’uwa Manase na bo barajabuka, biteguriye intambara kandi bari imbere y’Abisirayeli bandi, nk’uko Mose yari yabibabwiye.
Abagabo bashika ibihumbi mirongo ine bafise ibigwanisho biteguriye intambara ni bo bajabutse baca imbere y’ Uhoraho baja mu biyaya vya Yeriko kugwana.
Uwo musi Uhoraho ashira Yosuwa hejuru imbere y’Abisirayeli, na bo baramwubaha imisi yiwe yose, nk’uko bubaha Mose.
Uhoraho abarira Yosuwa ati:
“Barira abaherezi bareruye Isandugu y’Isezerano bave muri Yorodani.”
Nuko Yosuwa abwira abaherezi ati: “Nimuve muri Yorodani.”
Ba baherezi bava muri Yorodani bareruye ya Sandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho .
Ku musi ugira icumi w’ukwezi kwa mbere ni ho bajabuka Yorodani, bacumbika i Gilugali mu buseruko bwa Yeriko.
Aho i Gilugali ni ho Yosuwa yashinze ya mabuye icumi n’abiri bakura muri Yorodani.
Yosuwa abarira Abisirayeli ati: “Mu bihe bizoza, abana banyu nibababaza bati: ‘Aya mabuye asigura iki?’
Muzobabwire muti: ‘Abisirayeli bajabutse Yorodani bagendera kw’isi yumutse.’

Kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu yakamije uruzi Yorodani muvyibonera, gushika muhejeje kujabuka. Uhoraho yakoreye kuri Yorodani ivyo yakoreye ku Kiyaga Gitukura, igihe yatuma amazi akama imbere yacu, gushika twese tujabutse.
Ivyo Uhoraho yabikoze kugira ngo amahanga yose yo kw’isi aze amenye ububasha bw’ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho , kandi namwe mutinye Uhoraho Imana yanyu.”

Abami bose b’Abamori bo hakurya ya Yorodani, n’abami b’Abanyakanani bo ku nkengera ya Yorodani bumvise ko Uhoraho yakamije Yorodani kugira ngo Abisirayeli bajabuke, bose bacika ivutu, mu mitima yabo barihebura kubera ubwoba, ntibaba bakigira intege zo guhangara Abisirayeli ngo babagwanye.
Ico gihe Uhoraho abarira Yosuwa ati: “Rondera amabuye akarishe nk’imbugita, ukebe abagabo bose bo muri uru runganwe rwa kabiri rw’Abisirayeli.”
Nuko Yosuwa ategura amabuye akarishe nk’imbugita, akebera Abisirayeli i Gibeyati Haraloti.
Iki ni co catumye Yosuwa abikora: Abari bavuye muri Egiputa bafise imyaka yo kuja mu ntambara bose bari bapfiriye mu bugaragwa bariko bava muri Egiputa.
Abari bavuyeyo bose bari barakebwe, ariko abavukiye mu bugaragwa bari mu rugendo, bamaze kuva muri Egiputa, ntibari barakebwe.

Abisirayeli bamaze imyaka mirongo ine bayerera mu bugaragwa, gushika aho abari bafise imyaka yo kuja mu ntambara igihe bava muri Egiputa bose bapfuye bagahera, kuko bari bagararije Uhoraho . Uhoraho yari yarabarahiye ko batazobona igihugu yari yarasezeraniye ba sekuruza ko azokibaha, igihugu gitemba amata n’ubuki.
Nuko ahagurutsa abana mu gishingo ca ba se, abo rero ni bo Yosuwa yakevye. Ntibari bwigere bakebwa kuko batakebewe ku nzira baja i Kanani.
N’uko abagabo bose bamaze gukebwa, baguma aho bari bashinze amahema gushika bose bakize.
Maze Uhoraho abarira Yosuwa ati: “Uyu musi ndabakuyeko ibimaramare vyose vyatewe n’ubuja bwo muri Egiputa.” Ico kibanza gica citwa Gilugali gushika n’ubu.
Ku mugoroba wo ku musi ugira icumi na kane w’ukwo kwezi, bakiri ngaho i Gilugali mu biyaya vy’i Yeriko, Abisirayeli bahimbaza Pasika.
Ku musi wakurikiye Pasika, baca barya ivyokurya vyo muri ico gihugu, barya imikate itagira umwambiro n’ingano zikaranze.
Maze uhereye ku musi wakurikiye uwo baririyeko ivyokurya vyo muri ico gihugu, manu ntiyasubiriye kuboneka. Abisirayeli ntibongeye gusubira kuronka manu; uwo mwaka bariye ivyo basoromye i Kanani.
Yosuwa yegereje i Yeriko, yunamura amaso abona umugabo ahagaze imbere yiwe afise inkota mu minwe. Yosuwa aramwegera, aramubaza ati: “Mbega uri ku ruhande rwacu canke ku ruhande rw’abansi bacu?”

Na we aramwishura ati: “Sindi ku ruhande na rumwe. Ndi umugabisha w’ingabo z’ Uhoraho .” Nuko Yosuwa aca arunama, yikubita hasi, amuha icubahiro, hanyuma aramubaza ati: “None ushaka ko jewe umusavyi wawe nkora iki?”
Wa mugabisha w’ingabo z’ Uhoraho aramwishura ati: “Ambura ibirato vyawe, kuko aha hantu uhagaze ari ahera.” Nuko Yosuwa yambura ibirato vyiwe.
Kandi ico gihe, igisagara c’i Yeriko cari cugawe bikomeye kubera gutinya Abisirayeli. Nta muntu yasohoka canke ngo yinjire.
Maze Uhoraho abarira Yosuwa ati: “Ehe raba nshize Yeriko mu maboko yanyu, hamwe n’umwami waho n’abasoda baho bahambaye.
Mwe n’ingabo zawe nimuzunguruke igisagara rimwe gusa ku musi, muzobikore imisi itandatu.

Muzojane n’abaherezi indwi bitwaje inzamba zikozwe mu mahembe y’intama, bagendere imbere y’Isandugu. Ku musi ugira indwi, muzozunguruke ico gisagara incuro indwi, abo baherezi bariko baravuza izo nzamba.

Nimwumva abaherezi bavugije inzamba n’ijwi rirengera, abasoda bose bazoce na bo bashira ijwi hejuru basemerere cane, inzitiro z’igisagara zizoca zisenyuka, abantu bose bazoce binjira, umwe wese yinjirire aho azoba atumbereye.”
Nuko Yosuwa mwene Nuni aca akoranya abaherezi, ababwira ati: “Nimurerure Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho , abaherezi indwi bo muri mwebwe batware inzamba bagendere imbere yayo.”
Aca ategeka abasoda ati: “Genda! Nimuzunguruke igisagara, kandi habeho ingabo zigendera imbere y’Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho .”
Yosuwa ahejeje kubwira abantu ivyo, ba baherezi indwi bitwaje inzamba baca bagendera imbere y’ Uhoraho , bavuza za nzamba. Ya Sandugu y’Isezerano na yo irabakurikira.
Abasoda bafise ibigwanisho na bo baja imbere ya ba baherezi bitwaje inzamba, abandi bakurikira isandugu, kandi abaherezi bagenda baravuza inzamba.
Ariko Yosuwa yari yababwiye ati: “Ntimuze muvuze akaruru k’intambara, ntimuze muvuze urwamo, ndetse ntihaze hagire ijambo na rimwe muvuga, gushika umusi nzobabwira, ico gihe ni ho muzokoma akaruru.”
Nuko batwara Isandugu y’ Uhoraho , bazunguruka ico gisagara rimwe gusa, bahejeje abantu baca basubira mu mahema yabo, bararaho.
Bukeye Yosuwa avyuka kare mu gitondo, ba baherezi na bo barerura ya Sandugu y’ Uhoraho .
Abo baherezi indwi bitwaje inzamba baja imbere, bagendera imbere y’Isandugu y’ Uhoraho bavuza inzamba. Abasoda bafise ibigwanisho bakurikira Isandugu y’ Uhoraho , inzamba na zo ziriko ziravuzwa.
Ku musi ugira kabiri bazungurutse ico gisagara incuro imwe, baca basubira mu mahema yabo. Bamara imisi itandatu babigira gutyo.
Ku musi ugira indwi bavyuka hakiri kare cane, bazunguruka ico gisagara nk’uko bahora babigira, mugabo uwo musi bakizunguruka incuro indwi.
Ku ncuro igira indwi, abaherezi bavugije inzamba, Yosuwa aca abwira abantu ati: “Koma akaruru, kuko Uhoraho abahaye kino gisagara!
Igisagara n’ibikirimwo vyose bibe ishikanwa k’ Uhoraho . Ariko muzigame maraya Rahabu n’abo mu nzu yiwe, kuko yakingiye abatasi bacu.
Ntihagire ikintu na kimwe mu vyagenewe guturirwa mwisigariza, kuko mwoba mwikwegeye kuranduka, kandi mwoba mukwegeye ingorane n’umuvumo Abisirayeli mu mahema yabo.
Amafeza, inzahabu, n’ibikozwe mu mwakaka no mu vyuma, bibe ivyejejwe vy’ Uhoraho , bijanwe mu kigega ciwe.”
Inzamba ivuze, abantu baca bakoma akaruru n’inkomezi zabo zose. Ubwo nyene inzitiro z’i Yeriko zica zirasenyagurika, umusoda wese aca yinjirana aho yari atumbereye, bafata ico gisagara,
batikiza ivyo muri ico gisagara vyose, baranduza inkota abakibamwo bose: abagabo, abagore, abana, abatama, inka, intama n’indogoba.
Yosuwa abarira ba bagabo babiri baja gutata ico gisagara ati: “Nimuje ku nzu ya maraya, muzane abari muri yo bose nk’uko mwabimurahiye.”

Ba bagabo bari bagiye gutata ico gisagara baca binjira kwa Rahabu, baramusohokana; we na se, na nyina, abo bavukana hamwe n’abari muri iyo nzu bose. Basohokana umuryango wose, babashira hafi y’aho Abisirayeli bari bashinze amahema yabo.
Baca baturira igisagara cose, n’ivyari muri co, ariko inzahabu, ifeza, ibikozwe mu mwakaka no mu vyuma, babitwara mu bubiko bwo mu nzu y’ Uhoraho .
Maze Yosuwa arokora ubuzima bwa maraya Rahabu n’umuryango wiwe wose n’ivyo yari afise vyose, kuko yanyegeje abatasi Yosuwa yarungitse i Yeriko. Gushika n’ubu aracaba mu Bisirayeli.

Uwo mwanya Yosuwa ashira umuvumo kuri ico gisagara ati: “Haravumwe imbere y’ Uhoraho umuntu azosubira kwubaka iki gisagara Yeriko. Amatanguriro yaco niyayashiraho azobure umwana wiwe w’imfura, kandi ageze gushiraho inzugi z’irembo azobure umuhererezi.”
Uko ni ko Uhoraho yabanye na Yosuwa, na we amenyekana mu gihugu cose.

Ariko Abisirayeli barenga ku vyo Uhoraho yari yababujije ku bijanye n’ivyo yagize inyegu yiwe. Umugabo yitwa Akani mwene Karumi, Karumi mwene Zabudi, Zabudi mwene Zera, Zera wo mu muryango wa Yuda, yiba bimwe muri vyo. Uhoraho aca araraka kubw’Abisirayeli.

Yosuwa arungika abantu bari bavuye i Yeriko ngo baje gutera i Hayi, igisagara kiri hafi y’i Beti-Aveni, mu buseruko bwa Beteli, ababwira ati: “Nimugende mutate iriya ntara.” Nuko baragenda batata Hayi.

Bagarutse babarira Yosuwa bati: “Ntibikenewe ko urinda kurungika abantu bose i Hayi. Rungika abantu ibihumbi bibiri canke bitatu baje kuhafata, ntiwirirwe uragora ingabo zose kuko abakibamwo ari bake cane.”
Nuko abantu nk’ibihumbi bitatu baragenda, ariko abantu b’i Hayi barabirukana,

babicamwo abantu mirongo itatu na batandatu, barabirukana kuva ku marembo y’igisagara bashika ku mitumba y’ibitandara, bagenda barabica bamanuka. Abisirayeli babibonye bicwa n’ubwoba, imitima yabo icika ivutu.
Maze Yosuwa yitabagurirako impuzu, yubama hasi imbere y’Isandugu y’ Uhoraho , yirirwaho rirarenga. Abatware b’Abisirayeli na bo nyene babigenza batyo, bisiga n’imikungugu ku mitwe.
Yosuwa aravuga ati: “Yewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji, Ni iki catumye utujabukana Yorodani ukatuzana muri iki gihugu kugira ngo Abamori bakitwiciremwo? Ese iyo twigumira hakurya ya Yorodani?
Mbega Mwami mvuge iki ko Abisirayeli birukanywe n’abansi babo?
Abanyakanani n’abandi banyamahanga nibavyumva bazodukikuza bahanagure amazina yacu kw’isi. None izina ryawe rihambaye uzorigwanira ute?”
Uhoraho yishura Yosuwa ati: “Haguruka! Ni kubera iki wubamye hasi gutyo?
Isirayeli yacumuye. Yarenze kw’isezerano ryanje, iryo nabategetse kwubahiriza. Basahuye ivyari kuba inyegu y’ Uhoraho . Ntibivye gusa ahubwo baranabeshe, babinyegeza mu vyabo.
Ni co gituma Abisirayeli batashoboye guhagarara imbere y’abansi babo. Babahaye umugongo barabahunga kuko bikwegeye ugutikizwa. Sinzobana namwe kiretse mukuye muri mwebwe icagenewe kurandurwa cose.”

Genda ubwire abantu biyeze. Ubabwire uti: “Nimwiyeze kubera umusi w’ejo, kuko uku ari ko Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli avuze: Ivyari vyagenewe kuba inyegu y’ Uhoraho biri muri mwebwe, yemwe Bisirayeli. Ntimuzigera mushobora kunesha abansi banyu gushika mubikuye muri mwebwe.
Ejo mu gitondo muzokorane uko imiryango yanyu iri, Uhoraho azokwerekana umuryango uwakoze ivyo avukamwo. Abo muri uwo muryango bazoce bakorana, maze Uhoraho azokwerekana inzu uwo muntu akomokamwo.
Uwuzofatanwa ivyari kuba inyegu y’ Uhoraho azoranduzwe umuriro, aturiranwe n’ivyiwe vyose, kuko yarenze isezerano agakora ikizira mu Bisirayeli.”
Bukeye, hakiri kare mu gatondo, Yosuwa akoranya imiryango y’Abisirayeli, uwa Yuda uba ari wo ufatwa.
Mu bwoko bwa Yuda hafatwa Abakomoka kuri Zera. Abakomoka kuri Zera bakoranye hafatwa abo mu muryango wa Zabudi.
Yosuwa ahamagaza umugabo ku mugabo, hanyuma hafatwa Akani mwene Karumi, Karumi mwene Zabudi, Zabudi mwene Zera, Zera wo mu muryango wa Yuda.
Yosuwa abwira Akani ati: “Mwana wanje, nuhe Uhoraho icubahiro, Imana ya Isirayeli, uyishire hejuru. Mbwira ico wakoze kandi ntumpishe.”
Akani yishura Yosuwa ati: “Ni ivy’ukuri naracumuye k’ Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli.

Mu vyo twari twanyaze nabonyemwo ikanzu nziza iva i Babiloni, na shekeli amajana abiri z’ifeza, mbona n’ikigegene c’inzahabu gipima shekeli mirongo itanu nca ndavyipfuza. Nabizitse mu kuzimu mw’ihema ryanje, ifeza ni zo ziri musi y’ivyo vyose.”
Nuko Yosuwa arungika intumwa, zisanga ni ho binyegejwe nk’uko Akani yabivuze, na za feza ziri musi y’ibindi.
Baca babikurayo babizanira Yosuwa n’Abisirayeli bose, na bo babisanza imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Maze Yosuwa n’Abisirayeli bose bafata Akani mwene Zera, bafata za feza, ya kanzu, za nzahabu, abahungu biwe n’abakobwa biwe, inka, indogoba n’intama ziwe, ihema ryiwe, babajana mu kiyaya ca Akori.

Yosuwa amubwira ati: “Ni iki catumye udukwegera aya magorwa? Uyu musi Uhoraho arayaguteye nawe.” Maze Abisirayeli bose baca bamwicisha amabuye, bamwicana n’umuryango wiwe wose, ibiziga vyabo baca barabiturira.

Akani baca bamurundako ikirundo kinini c’amabuye, kandi kiracariho gushika n’ubu. Ni co gituma ico kiyaya baciye bacita Akabande ka Akori [bisigura akabande k’ivyago] kandi ni ko kacitwa gushika n’ubu. Maze uburake bw’ Uhoraho buca burahwama. Gushika n’uno musi aho hantu hitwa Akabande ka Akori.
Uhoraho abarira Yosuwa ati: “Ntutinye, ntucike intege. Hitana ingabo zawe zose muduge gutera Hayi. Kuko namaze kuguha intsinzi ku mwami w’i Hayi, ku bantu biwe, ku gisagara ciwe no ku gihugu ciwe.
Mugirire Hayi nk’ivyo mwagiriye Yeriko n’umwami waho, kiretse ko ivyo muzonyaga muzovyitwarira bikaba ivyanyu. Mubatege umutego bave mu gisagara.”
Nuko Yosuwa n’ingabo ziwe zose baja gutera i Hayi. Atoranya abasoda ibihumbi mirongo itatu mu banyentambara bakomeye abarungika mw’ijoro
abaha amategeko ati: “Nyumviriza neza! Mugende mubatege umutego baze inyuma y’igisagara. Ntimukije kure, kandi mwese mugume mugavye.
Jewe n’abo turi kumwe tuzokwegera igisagara, maze abaho nibaza kutugwanya nka kumwe kwa mbere, tuzokwigira nk’ababahunga.
Bazoca badukurikira gushika tubashikane kure y’igisagara, bibaza bati: ‘Baraduhunze nk’uko baduhunze ubwa mbere.’
Mu gihe tuzoba turiko turabahunga, namwe muzoce muva aho mwinyegeje mufate ico gisagara. Uhoraho Imana yanyu araja kukibaha mu maboko yanyu.
Nimwamara kugifata, muce mugiturira. Mukore ivyo Uhoraho yategetse. Ayo ni yo mategeko ndabahaye.”

Nuko Yosuwa aca arabarungika, baca baja mu bibanza vyo kwinyegezamwo, babunda hagati ya Beteli na Hayi, amaja mu burengero bwa Hayi, ariko iryo joro Yosuwa iryo joro ararana n’abandi aho bari bashinze amahema.
Mu gitondo hatarabona neza Yosuwa avyura ingabo ziwe n’abatware b’Abisirayeli, bagenda bagana Hayi, agendera imbere yabo.
Ingabo zose zari zajanye na we ziragenda zishika imbere y’igisagara. Baca bashinga amahema mu buraruko bwa Hayi, hasigara ikiyaya hagati yabo n’ico gisagara.
Yosuwa yari kumwe n’abasoda bashika ibihumbi bitanu, abo binyegeza hagati ya Beteli n’i Hayi mu ruhande rwo mu burengero bw’ico gisagara.
Abasoda bagenerwa ibibanza baba barabamwo; ikibanza nyamukuru gishingwa mu buraruko bw’igisagara, abandi bashinga amahema mu burengero bwaco. Iryo joro, Yosuwa wewe arara mu kiyaya.

Umwami w’i Hayi abonye Abisirayeli mu kiyaya, aca akoranya ingabo ziwe zose zihutira kuja kubatera kare mu gitondo ngo babasange aharabana n’ikiyaya Araba. Ariko ntibari bazi ko hariho ababibundiye inyuma y’igisagara.
Yosuwa n’Abisirayeli barabareka barabakurikira, baca biruka babakwegera mu bugaragwa.
Abagabo bose b’i Hayi bahamagarirwa kubirukako, gutyo mu gukurikira Yosuwa baba bagiye kure y’igisagara cabo.
Nta mugabo n’umwe yasigaye i Hayi canke i Beteli adakurikiye Abisirayeli. Basiga igisagara cuguruye barabakurikira.

Uhoraho aca abarira Yosuwa ati: “Ramvura ukuboko kwawe uduze icumu ryawe uritumbereje kuri Hayi, kuko ntanze ico gisagara mu maboko yawe.” Nuko Yosuwa aca atumbereza icumu riri mu ntoke ziwe ico gisagara.
Yosuwa amaze gutanga ico kimenyetso, abari babunze inyuma y’igisagara baca barahaguruka, bava aho bari babunze biruka baja mu gisagara, baragifata, ubwo nyene baca baragiturira.

Abagabo b’i Hayi bahindukiye inyuma, babona umwotsi uva mu gisagara upfunduka uduga hejuru, ariko ntibari bagifise akaryo ko guhunga, kuko Abisirayeli bari bahungiye mu bugaragwa baciye babahindukirira.
Yosuwa n’Abisirayeli babonye ivyo bateguye kuri ico gisagara bikunze, bakabona n’umwotsi upfunduka uva muri ico gisagara, baca barahindukira batera abantu b’i Hayi.
Bamwe bari babibundiye na bo nyene baca bava mu gisagara barabatera, babata hagati, Abisirayeli babakikuza impande zose. Isirayeli irabatikiza, ntihagira n’uwusigara canke ngo abatoroke.
Ariko umwami w’i Hayi baramuretse, bamuzanira Yosuwa ari muzima.
Abisirayeli bamaze kwica Ab’i Hayi bose babatsinda mu mitumba no mu biyaya iyo bari bahungiye, bose bamaze kwicishwa inkota, baciye baja i Hayi kwica abari basigayeyo bose.
Abagabo n’abagore ibihumbi cumi na bibiri ni bo bishwe uwo musi; kandi ni bo baba i Hayi.
Kuko Yosuwa yari yagumye adugije icumu ryiwe gushika ababa i Hayi bose baranduwe.
Abisirayeli basahura ibintu vyo muri ico gisagara, barabitwara nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabibariye Yosuwa.
Nuko Yosuwa aturira Hayi hasigara ari ikirundo c’ivyasambutse gusa, hasigara ari igisanze gushika n’ubu.

Maze Yosuwa amanika umwami w’i Hayi ku giti, agumaho gushika ku mugoroba. Izuba rirenze, Yosuwa abwira abantu ngo bamanure ikiziga ciwe, ngo bagiterere imbere y’irembo ry’igisagara. Baca bakirundako ikirundo c’amabuye kinini cane, kandi kiracariho gushika n’ubu.
Nuko Yosuwa aca yubakira igicaniro Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli, hafi y’umusozi Ebalu,

nk’uko Mose umusavyi w’ Uhoraho yari yarabitegetse Abisirayeli. Yacubatse akurikije uko vyanditswe mu Gitabu c’Ivyagezwe vya Mose, acubaka mu mabuye atabaje, ata cuma cigeze kiyakorako. Kuri co, ahashikanira Uhoraho ikimazi c’ishimwe n’ibimazi vyo guturirwa.
Bari ngaho nyene, Yosuwa yandika kuri ayo mabuye Ivyagezwe vya Mose, Abisirayeli bose barorera.

Abisirayeli bose, bari kumwe n’abakuru babo, abatware n’abacamanza, bose bari bahagaze; bamwe ku ruhande rumwe abandi ku rundi rw’Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho baraba abaherezi b’Abalewi bayireruye. Bose abanyamahanga baba mu Bisirayeli, n’abasangwa bose bari ngaho. Igice kimwe c’abantu bari bahagaze imbere y’umusozi Gerizimu, ikindi cari gihagaze imbere y’umusozi Ebalu, nk’uko Mose umusavyi w’ Uhoraho yari yarabitegetse igihe yatanga inyigisho z’ingene bazohora bahezagira abantu ba Isirayeli.
Inyuma y’ivyo, Yosuwa asoma amajambo yose yanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyagezwe, asoma imigisha n’imivumo yose nk’uko yanditswe muri ico gitabu c’ivyagezwe.
Nta jambo na rimwe Mose yategetse Yosuwa atasomeye ishengero ryose ry’Abisirayeli, harimwo n’abagore n’abana, n’abanyamahanga baba muri bo.

headings.text: Bongera kunagura isezerano ku musozi Ebalu

verses.text: Nuko inkuru y’ivyabaye ishikira abami bose bo mu burengero bwa Yorodani, mu karere k’imisozi miremire, mu biyaya no ku nkengera z’Ikiyaga Mediterane, gushika i Libani: abami b’Abaheti, ab’Abamori, ab’Abanyakanani, ab’Abaperizi, ab’Abahiwi hamwe n’ab’Abayebusi.
Bose baca barakorana kugira ngo batere Yosuwa n’Abisirayeli.
Ariko abantu b’i Gibeyoni bumvise ivyo Yosuwa yakoreye Yeriko na Hayi,
baca bakoresha urwenge, barungikira intumwa Yosuwa, bazirungika ku ndogoba bashasheko imifuko yatabaguritse, babaha n’imikuza y’imishire imenaguritse.
Bambara ibirato bishaje kandi biteye ibiremo, n’impuzu zitabaguritse. Imikate batwaye yose yari yumye, iyindi yaraguye ifira.
Maze baja iyo Yosuwa ari mu mahema i Gilugali, bamubwira ari kumwe n’abandi Bisirayeli bati: “Tuje tuva mu gihugu ca kure cane, tuje gusaba ngo tugiriranire amasezerano y’amahoro.”
Abisirayeli babwira abo Bahiwi bati: “Mbega twobwirwa n’iki ko mutari abo ngaha hafi yacu? Kuko nimba muri aba hafi, nta masezerano y’amahoro tugiriranira.”
Bishura Yosuwa bati: “Turi abasavyi bawe.” Yosuwa arababaza ati: “Muri ba nde? Muje muva he?”
Baramwishura bati: “Twebwe abasavyi banyu twaje tuva mu gihugu ca kure, kuko twumvise ingene Uhoraho Imana yanyu ahambaye, twumva n’ivyo yakoreye Egiputa.
Twarumvise kandi ivyo yakoreye abami babiri b’Abamori hakurya ya Yorodani, ari bo Sihoni umwami w’i Heshiboni na Ogi umwami w’i Bashani yaba i Ashitaroti.
None abakuru bacu n’ababa mu gihugu cacu bose batubwiye bati: Nimutekere ivyo muzorira mu rugendo, mugende mubashikire mubabwire muti: Turi abasavyi banyu, nimuze tugiriranire isezerano ry’amahoro.
Iyi mikate yari ishushe igihe twayitekera tuva i muhira. Ariko raba yarumye, yaramaze no kugwa ifira.
N’iyi mikuza yari yuzuye igihe twaza ariko ubu raba ingene imaze kumenagurika. Impuzu n’ibirato vyacu vyahereye ku nzira.”
Maze Abisirayeli baca batangura gusuzuma ivyo bifungurwa baje bararira mu rugendo badasiguje Uhoraho .
Yosuwa aca abasezeranira isezerano ry’amahoro, abarongozi b’iryo hanga na bo nyene babishigikiza indahiro.
Haciye imisi itatu bagiriraniye iryo sezerano, Abisirayeli baca bumva ko Ab’i Gibiyoni ari ababanyi babo, ko babana hafi.
Abisirayeli baca bafata urugendo, mu misi itatu bashikira ibisagara vyabo: Gibeyoni, Kefira, Beroti hamwe na Kiriyati-Yeyarimu.
Ariko Abisirayeli ntibabaye bakibatera, kuko abarongozi b’ihanga ryabo bari babarahiye mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli. Maze ikoraniro ryose ryidodombera abarongozi,
ariko abarongozi bababwira bati: “Twabarahiye mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli none ubu ntidushobora kubakorako.
Iki ni co tuzobakorera: Tuzobareka babeho, kugira ngo uburake bw’ Uhoraho ntibudutikize kuko twoba turenze indahiro twabarahiye.”
Barabandanya bati: “Reka babeho mugabo bazobe abo kudusaturira inkwi no kuvomera amazi ihanga ryacu.” Maze isezerano ry’abarongozi rica rirubahirizwa.
Yosuwa akoranya Ab’i Gibiyoni, ababwira ati: “Ni iki catumye muduhenda muti: ‘Turi abantu ba kure cane,’ kandi muba hafi yacu?
Muri musi y’umuvumo: Ntimuzigera na rimwe muva ku gikorwa co gusatura inkwi no kuvomera amazi inzu y’Imana yanje.”

Na bo bishura Yosuwa bati: “Twebwe abasavyi bawe twabwiwe neza ingene Uhoraho Imana yanyu yari yategetse umusavyi wayo Mose ngo abahe iki gihugu cose ngo murandure abakibamwo bose. Natwe twaciye dutinya ko mwoturandura, ni co catumye dukora dutyo.
None rero turi mu biganza vyanyu, nimutugire uko mubona bibereye.”
Nuko Yosuwa abakiza amaboko y’Abisirayeli, ntibabica.
Kuva uwo musi aca abagira abashenyi b’inkwi n’abavomyi b’amazi y’Abisirayeli, n’abajejwe kurondera ibikenewe vyose vy’igicaniro c’ Uhoraho mu kibanza azohitamwo. Kandi ivyo baracabikora kugeza n’ubu.

Ico gihe Adoni-Zedeki umwami w’i Yerusalemu yumva ko Yosuwa yafashe Hayi akahasambura rwose, akahagirira nk’uko yagiriye Yeriko n’umwami waho, yumva kandi ko abantu b’i Gibeyoni bagiriraniye isezerano ry’amahoro na Isirayeli, kandi ko bifatanije na bo.
We n’abantu biwe baca bahagarika imitima kubera ivyo, kuko Gibeyoni cari igisagara gikomeye cangana na kimwe mu bisagara vy’abami, casumba Hayi mu bunini, kandi abantu baho bari abagwanyi bakomeye.
Nuko Adoni-Zedeki umwami w’i Yerusalemu atumako Hohamu umwami w’i Heburoni, Piramu umwami w’i Yarimuti, Yafiya umwami w’i Lakishi, hamwe na Debiri umwami wa Eguloni.
Ababwira ati: “Nimuze mumfashe gutera ab’i Gibeyoni, kuko bagiranye isezerano ry’amahoro na Yosuwa hamwe n’Abisirayeli.”
Nuko abo bami b’Abamori uko ari batanu; uw’i Yerusalemu, uw’i Heburoni, uw’i Yarimuti, uw’i Lakishi hamwe n’uw’i Eguloni, bakoraniriza ingabo zabo hamwe, baraduga baja gutera i Gibeyoni.

Ab’i Gibeyoni na bo baca barungikira intumwa Yosuwa aho yari mu mahema i Gilugali, bamubwira bati: “Ntuhebe abasavyi bawe! Duga vuba udutabare! Ngwino udufashe kuko abami b’Abamori bo mu mitumba miremire bakoranye ngo badutere.”
Nuko Yosuwa aca afata urugendo ava i Gilugali ari kumwe n’abasoda biwe bose, hamwe n’abahizi biwe mu kugwana, baja i Gibeyoni.
Uhoraho abarira Yosuwa ati: “Ntubatinye, bose nabatanze mu maboko yawe. Nta n’umwe azoshobora kuguhagarara imbere.”
Bamaze ijoro ryose bagenda bava i Gilugali, Yosuwa arabahwikira.

Uhoraho abateza gucika ivutu imbere y’Abisirayeli, baronka intsinzi y’agahebuza, i Gibeyoni. Abisirayeli barabakurikira mw’ibarabara riduga i Beti-Horoni, babica ingenda kugeza bashitse i Azeka n’i Makeda.
Bakiriko barahunga Abisirayeli bamanuka ibarabara riva i Beti-Horoni rija muri Azeka, Uhoraho atibagura urubura rumeze nk’amabuye, abishwe n’urwo rubura basumba abishwe n’inkota y’Abisirayeli.

Uwo musi Uhoraho aha Abisirayeli intsinzi ku Bamori, Yosuwa asenga Uhoraho ari imbere y’Abisirayeli ati: “Ewe zuba, hagarara ugume hejuru ya Gibeyoni, kandi nawe kwezi, ugume wakira hejuru y’ikiyaya ca Ayaloni.”

Izuba rirahagarara ritikakaza, n’ukwezi kuguma aho kwari kuri, gushika abagize iryo hanga bihoye abansi babo, nk’uko vyanditswe mu gitabu ca Yashari. Izuba ryagumye rihagaze hagati mu kirere, ntiryarenga, hafi umusi wose.
Nta musi wigeze kubaho umeze nk’uwo kuva isi ibaho canke mu nyuma, aho Uhoraho yishura umwana w’umuntu gutyo. Mu vy’ukuri uwo musi Uhoraho ni we yagwanira Isirayeli.
Maze Yosuwa n’Abisirayeli basubira mu mahema yabo i Gilugali.
Abo bami batanu bari bahunze binyegeza mu kinogo kirekire kiri musi y’ikibuye kinini i Makeda.
Yosuwa yumvise ko hari ababonye abo bami ko binyegeje muri ico kinogo i Makeda,
aca avuga ati: “Tembagariza ibibuye bininibinini mu rwinjiriro rw’ico kinogo, mushireho n’abantu bahacunge.
Ariko ntimuhagarare, mubandanye mukurikira abansi banyu, mubatere mubaciye inyuma, kandi mubabuze gushika mu bisagara vyabo, kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu yabashize mu maboko yanyu.”
Nuko Yosuwa n’Abisirayeli barabica barabamara, ariko bakeya bo muri bo barashobora guhunga no gushikira ibisagara vyabo bizitiye cane.
Abasoda bose batabaruka impore, bashikira Yosuwa mu nsago z’i Makeda. Kuva ico gihe nta n’umwe yasubiriye kwubahuka kugira ico avuga kibi ku Bisirayeli.
Yosuwa aravuga ati: “Ugurura ico kinogo musohore abo bami batanu mubanzanire.”
Nuko bazana abo bami bose uko ari batanu: uw’i Yerusalemu, uw’i Heburoni, uw’i Yarimuti, uw’i Lakishi, n’uw’i Eguloni.

Abo bami babazaniye Yosuwa, aca ahamagaza abagabo bose b’Abisirayeli, abwira n’abagabisha b’ingabo zabazanye ati: “Nimuze muhonyoze ibirenge vyanyu ku mazosi y’aba bami.” Nuko baregera bahonyoza ibirenge vyabo ku mazosi yabo.
Yosuwa abwira abantu biwe ati: “Ntimuze mwigere mugira ubwoba canke ngo mucike intege. Mushikame mwambare inkomezi. Uku ni ko Uhoraho azokorera abansi bose mugiye kuzogwanya.”
Hanyuma Yosuwa aca yica abo bami uko ari batanu, aca abamanika ku biti, bagumaho gushika bwije.

Izuba rirenze, Yosuwa aca atanga itegeko ryo kubamanura, babata muri ca kinogo kiri musi y’ikibuye kinini bari binyegejemwo. Mu rwinjiriro rw’ico kinogo baca bahugaza ikibuye kinini, kandi ni ho kikiri gushika n’ubu.

Uwo musi nyene, Yosuwa afata igisagara ca Makeda aragisambura. Yicisha inkota abakibamwo bose harimwo n’umwami waho, ntiyasiga n’umwe. Yarabaranduye bose, agirira umwami w’i Makeda ivyo yagiriye umwami w’i Yeriko.
Inyuma y’aho, Yosuwa n’Abisirayeli baciye bava i Makeda baja i Libuna, barahatera.

Na ho nyene Uhoraho atanga igisagara n’umwami waho mu maboko y’Abisirayeli. Yosuwa yicisha inkota abo muri ico gisagara n’abakibamwo, ntiyasiga n’umwe wo kuvuga inkuru. Umwami waho amugirira nk’ivyo yagiriye uw’i Yeriko.
Yosuwa n’Abisirayeli bose bava i Libuna baja i Lakishi, barahatera.
Uhoraho atanga Lakishi mu maboko y’Abisirayeli. Yosuwa ahafata ku musi ugira kabiri. Abo mu gisagara bose abaranduza inkota, nk’uko yari yabikoze i Libuna.
Kandi ico gihe, Horamu umwami w’i Gezeri, yari yaje gufasha uw’i Lakishi, ariko Yosuwa amuneshanya n’ingabo ziwe, ntiharokoka n’umwe.
Yosuwa n’Abisirayeli baca bava i Lakishi baja muri Eguloni, barahatera.
Bahafata uwo musi nyene, bicisha inkota abantu bose bahaba, barabahonya, nk’uko bari babigize i Lakishi.
Yosuwa n’Abisirayeli bose bava muri Eguloni, baduga i Heburoni, barahatera.
Bafata ico gisagara bacisha inkota abantu bose, harimwo umwami waho, imihana yaho n’abayibamwo bose. Nta n’umwe basigaje. Kandi nk’uko yari yabigize muri Eguloni yica abantu bose bahaba.
Inyuma y’aho Yosuwa n’Abisirayeli bose barahindukira batera i Debiri.

Bafata ico gisagara n’umwami waho, n’imihana yaho, babicisha inkota. Abahaba bose barabishe ntibasiga n’umwe. Akorera Debiri n’umwami waho nk’ivyo yakoreye i Libuna n’umwami waho, co kimwe na Heburoni.

Uko ni ko Yosuwa yafashe ivyo bihugu vyose vyo mu karere k’imisozi miremire, i Negebu, mu biyaya vyo mu burengero biri musi y’imisozi hamwe n’imimanuko yayo, abifatana n’abami baho. Ntiyasize n’umwe. Yatikije igihumeka cose nk’uko Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli yari yarabimubwiye.
Yosuwa arabarandura bose uhereye i Kadeshi Baruneya gushika i Gaza, no mu ntara yose kuva i Gosheni gushika i Gibeyoni.
Ivyo bihugu n’abo bami bose Yosuwa abafata mu gitero kimwe yagize kuri bo, kuko Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli ari yo yabagwanira.
Maze Yosuwa n’Abisirayeli bose barahindukira basubira mu mahema yabo i Gilugali.

headings.text: Izuba rihagarara hejuru y’ikiyaya c’i Gibeyoni
Abisirayeli bafata ibisagara vyo mu bumanuko

verses.text: Yabini umwami w’i Hazori avyumvise, aca arungikira intumwa Yobabu umwami w’i Madoni, abami b’i Shimuroni n’umwami w’i Akishafu,
abami bo mu karere k’imisozi miremire mu buraruko, abo mu kiyaya Araba mu bumanuko bw’i Kinereti, abo mu kiyaya n’ab’i Nafoti Dori mu burengero,
n’Abanyakanani mu buseruko no mu burengero; n’Abamori, n’Abaheti, n’Abaperizi, n’Abayebusi bo mu gihugu c’imisozi miremire, hamwe n’Abahiwi bo musi ya Herumoni mu ntara ya Misipa.
Bose baza n’ingabo zabo zose, n’amafarasi menshi, n’imikogote myinshi: bari benshi cane bameze kurya kw’umusenyi wo ku nkengera y’ikiyaga.
Abo bami bose baja hamwe, bagira ikambi imwe ku mazi y’i Meromi kugira ngo batere Abisirayeli.
Uhoraho abarira Yosuwa ati: “Ntubatinye kuko ejo nk’aya masaha nzobatanga mu maboko y’Abisirayeli bameze nk’abapfuye. Muzotemagure ibinono vy’amafarasi yabo, muturire n’imikogote yabo.”
Nuko Yosuwa n’ingabo ziwe zose baja kubagwanya, babatera giturumbuka babasanze aho bari ku mazi y’i Meromi,

Uhoraho abatanga mu maboko ya Isirayeli. Abisirayeli barabatsinda, barabirukana gushika mu ntara nini y’i Sidoni, ahitwa Misirefoti-Mayimu, no mu kiyaya ca Misipehi mu buseruko, barabica ntihasigara n’umwe.
Yosuwa abagirira nk’uko Uhoraho yari yamubwiye: ifarasi bazicagagura ibinono, imikogote na yo barayiturira.
Ico gihe Yosuwa aca arahindukira afata Hazori, umwami waho amwicisha inkota. Hazori hari harigeze kuba umugwa mukuru w’ubwo bwami bwose.
Ababa muri ico gisagara bose bicishwa inkota, barabahonya ntibasigaza umuntu n’umwe agihema, bongera baturira Hazori.
Yosuwa afata ivyo bisagara n’abami bavyo, abicisha inkota, arabahonya bose nk’uko Mose umusavyi w’ Uhoraho yari yarabimutegetse.
Ariko Abisirayeli ntibaturiye ibindi bisagara vyose vyo mu misozi, kiretse Hazori conyene caturiwe na Yosuwa.
Abisirayeli basahura ibintu vyose vyo muri ivyo bisagara harimwo n’ibitungwa, barabitwara, ariko abantu bo muri vyo bose babicisha inkota, ntibasigaza n’umwe.
Ivyo Uhoraho yari yabitegetse umusavyi wiwe Mose, kandi Mose na we yabitegetse Yosuwa, hanyuma Yosuwa na we arabishitsa. Nta kintu na kimwe atakoze mu vyo Uhoraho yategetse Mose.

Maze Yosuwa afata igihugu cose: ahari imisozi miremire, intara ya Negebu yose, intara yose ya Gosheni, hamwe n’intara zigizwe n’imisozi migufimigufi yo mu burengero, ikiyaya Araba n’imisozi ya Isirayeli iri kumwe n’imyonga yayo,
kuva ku musozi Halaki uduga utumbereye i Seyiri, gushika i Bayali-Gadi mu kiyaya c’i Libani hepfo y’umusozi Herumoni. Afata abami baho bose arabica.
Yosuwa yamaze igihe kinini agira ibitero kuri abo bami.
Kiretse Abahiwi baba i Gibeyoni bonyene, nta gisagara na kimwe kindi cigeze gisaba ko bogiriranira isezerano ry’amahoro n’Abisirayeli, ibisagara vyose yabifashe habanje kuba intambara.
Uhoraho yari yakomantaje imitima yabo ngo batere Abisirayeli, kugira ngo Abisirayeli na bo babahonye bose, babatikize ata kigongwe, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yarabitegetse Mose.

Ico gihe Yosuwa aca aragenda atikiza Abanaki bo mu gihugu c’imisozi miremire: kuva i Heburoni, i Debiri n’i Anabu, kuva mu ntara y’imisozi miremire y’i Buyuda, no kuva mu ntara y’imisozi miremire ya Isirayeli. Yosuwa arabahonya bose hamwe n’ibisagara vyabo.
Nta muntu wo mu ba Anaki n’umwe yasigaye muri ico gihugu ca Isirayeli, kiretse abari i Gaza, i Gati no muri Ashidodi.
Nuko Yosuwa afata ico gihugu cose nk’uko Uhoraho yari yarabitegetse Mose, akigaburira Abisirayeli nk’iragi ryabo, akibagaburira uko imiryango yabo ingana. Maze igihugu kibona kuruhuka intambara.

headings.text: Yosuwa atsinda abami bo mu buraruko

verses.text: Aba ni bo bami b’ibihugu Abisirayeli banesheje bagafata ibihugu vyabo biri mu buseruko bwa Yorodani, uvuye ku kagezi k’uruzi Arunoni ugashika ku musozi Herumoni, harimwo igice c’amaja mu buseruko bw’ikiyaya Araba.

Sihoni umwami w’Abamori yaba i Heshiboni. Yaganza kuva i Aroweri ku nkengera y’akagezi k’uruzi Arunoni ugashika ku ruzi Yaboki, ari na rwo rwari urubibe rw’Abamoni. Aho harimwo n’igice c’intara ya Gileyadi.

Yatwara kandi no mu buseruko bw’ikiyaya Araba uhereye ku Kiyaga c’i Galilaya gushika ku kiyaga ca Araba, ari co kiyaga kitagiramwo ibinyabuzima, n’i Beti-Yeshimoti, n’amaja mu bumanuko musi y’imisozi y’i Pisiga.
Umwami Ogi wa Bashani, umwe mu masigarira y’Abarefayimu, yatwara ahitwa Ashitaroti no muri Edireyi.

Yatwara intara iva ku musozi Herumoni, Saleka, na Bashani yose mu buseruko, n’amaja mu burengero ku mbibe z’abantu b’i Geshuri n’i Mayaka, n’igice ca Gileyadi ugashika ku rubibe rwa Sihoni umwami w’i Heshiboni.

Aho, Mose umusavyi w’ Uhoraho ni we yahafashe ari kumwe n’Abisirayeli. Maze Mose umusavyi w’Imana ahagaburira imiryango ya Reyubeni n’iya Gadi, hamwe n’igice c’umuryango wa Manase ngo habe intara zabo.

Aba ni bo bami n’ibice vy’igihugu abo bami batwara aho Yosuwa n’Abisirayeli bafashe, mu burengero bwa Yorodani, kuva i Bayali-Gadi mu kiyaya ca Libani, gushika ku musozi Halaki, uduga utumbereye i Seyiri, Yosuwa yagaburiye ico gihugu imiryango y’Abisirayeli ngo kibe icabo bazokwamana.

Muri ico gihugu, hariho ahari imisozi miremire, ahari imisozi migufimigufi yo mu burengero, hakaba ikiyaya Araba, imimanuko y’imisozi, ubugaragwa bw’i Negebu, hamwe n’ibihugu vy’Abaheti, Abamori, Abanyakanani, Abaperizi, Abahiwi n’Abayebusi. Abami baneshejwe bari:
Umwami w’i Yeriko Umwami w’i Hayi hafi y’i Beteli
Umwami w’i Yerusalemu Umwami w’i Heburoni
Umwami w’i Yarimuti Umwami w’i Lakishi
Umwami w’i Eguloni Umwami w’i Gezeri
Umwami w’i Debiri Umwami w’i Beti-Gaderi
Umwami w’i Horuma Umwami w’i Aradi
Umwami w’i Libuna Umwami w’i Adulamu
Umwami w’i Makeda Umwami w’i Beteli
Umwami w’i Tapuwa Umwami w’i Heferi
Umwami w’i Afeki Umwami w’i Lasharoni
Umwami w’i Madoni Umwami w’i Hazori
Umwami w’i Shimuroni Meroni Umwami w’i Akishafu
Umwami w’i Tanaki Umwami w’i Megido
Umwami w’i Kedeshi Umwami w’i Yokineyamu i Karumeli
Umwami w’i Dori mu gisagara ca Nafoti Dori Umwami w’i Goyimu i Gilugali
Umwami w’i Tiriza. Bose hamwe bari abami mirongo itatu n’umwe.

headings.text: Abami batsinzwe bo mu buseruko bwa Yorodani

verses.text: Yosuwa amaze gusaza, Uhoraho amubwira ati: “Uriko urasaza kandi haracariho igice kinini c’igihugu kitarafatwa.
Ahari hagisigaye gufatwa ni aha: intara zose z’Abafilisitiya n’Abageshuri,

uhereye ku ruzi Shihori mu buseruko bwa Egiputa gushika mu ntara ya Ekuroni mu buraruko, kandi aho hose hitirirwa Abanyakanani naho hari higanziwe n’abatware batanu b’Abafilisitiya batwara Gaza, Ashidodi, Ashikeloni, Gati na Ekuroni; mu ntara y’Abavimu
mu bumanuko; intara yose y’Abanyakanani, uhereye muri Arahu ho mu Basidoni, gushika kure muri Afeki, no ku rubibe bahana n’intara y’Abamori;
intara y’Abagebali; hamwe n’intara yose y’i Libani irimwo imisozi gushika mu buseruko, kuva i Bayali-Gadi ukamanuka hepfo y’umusozi Herumoni gushika i Lebo-Hamati.

Nayo ababa mu karerere k’imisozi miremire, uhereye i Libani ugashika i Misirefoti-Mayimu, ahaba Abanyesidoni hose, nzohabirukana jewe nyene imbere y’Abisirayeli. Ariko wewe urabe neza ko igihugu wakigaburiye Abisirayeli nk’iragi ryabo, kandi nk’uko nabikubwiye,
ukibagabure nk’iragi ry’Abisirayeli hagati y’imiryango icenda, n’igice c’umuryango wa Manase.”
Ikindi gice c’umuryango wa Manase, umuryango wa Reyubeni hamwe n’uwa Gadi bari bamaze kuronka iragi ryabo mu buseruko bwa Yorodani, kuko Mose umusavyi w’ Uhoraho yari yarahabagaburiye.

Hari kuva ahitwa Aroweri no ku nkengera y’akagezi k’uruzi Arunoni, no kuva ku gisagara kiri hagati ahaherereye ako kagezi, ugashiramwo n’imisozi migufimigufi y’i Medeba ukagenda ugashika kure, ahitwa Diboni,
hamwe n’ibisagara vyose vya Sihoni umwami w’Abamori yatwara aba i Heshiboni, gushika ku rubibe rw’Abamoni.
Harimwo kandi na Gileyadi, n’intara yarimwo abantu b’Abageshuri na Mayaka, umusozi Herumoni wose, Bashani yose gushika i Saleka,
hamwe n’ubwami bwose bwatwarwa na Ogi w’i Bashani yatwariye i Ashitaroti n’i Edireyi, akaba ari n’umwe mu bami ba nyuma b’Abarefayimu. Mose yari yarabanesheje bose, abanyaga igihugu cabo.
Ariko Abisirayeli ntibigeze birukana abantu b’i Geshuri n’i Mayaka, bagumye babana n’Abisirayeli gushika n’ubu.
Mugabo umuryango wa Lewi wowo nta ragi wahawe kuko ibimazi vyashikanwa ku bicaniro vy’ Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli, ni vyo vyari iragi ryabo, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yarabibasezeraniye.
Aha ni ho Mose yahaye umuryango wa Reyubeni akurikije abakuru b’inzu ziwugize:
Intara iva kuri Aroweri no ku nkengera y’akagezi k’uruzi Arunoni, no kuva ku gisagara kiri hagati ahaherereye kuri ako kagezi, ugashiramwo n’imisozi migufimigufi y’i Medeba
hamwe na Heshiboni n’ibisagara vyaho vyo mu misozi migufimigufi, ushizemwo na Diboni, Bamoti-Bayali, Beti-Bayali-Meyoni,
Yahiza, Kedemoti, Mefayati,
Kiriyatayimu, Sibuma, Zereti-Shahari ku misozi no mu kiyaya,
Beti-Peyori, ku mimanuko ya Pisiga, n’i Beti-Yeshimoti,

ibisagara vyo ku misozi migufimigufi hamwe n’ahantu hose Sihoni umwami w’Abamori yatwara ari i Heshiboni. Mose yaramutsinze hamwe n’abakuru b’Abamidiyani, ari bo Evi, Rekemu, Zuri, Huri na Reba, ari bo baganwa bo muri ico gihugu bari begamiye Sihoni.
Muri abo bishwe n’Abisirayeli mu ntambara, harimwo umupfumu Balamu mwene Beyori, uwo bicishije inkota.
Urubibe rw’umuryango wa Reyubeni rwari rugizwe n’inkengera ya Yorodani. Ibi bisagara n’imihana yaho ni vyo vyatanzwe nk’iragi ku muryango wa Reyubeni, hakurikijwe abakuru b’ingo ziwugize.
Aha ni ho Mose yahaye umuryango wa Gadi, hakurikijwe abakuru b’inzu ziwugize:
Intara yabo yari igizwe na Yazeri, ibisagara vyose vy’i Gileyadi, n’igice c’igihugu c’Abamoni gushika i Aroweri hafi y’i Raba
hamwe no kuva i Heshiboni kugeza i Rama Misipehi n’i Betonimu, hakongera hakava i Mahanayimu hagashika i Debiri.

Kandi no mu kiyaya bahawe Beti-Haramu, Beti-Nimura, Sukoti, Zafoni, n’igice c’ubwami bwa Sihoni yatwara ari i Heshiboni, uruhande rwo mu burengero rwa Yorodani, intara iduga igashika aho Ikiyaga c’i Kinereti giherera.
Ivyo bisagara n’imihana ivyegamiye ni vyo vyahawe umuryango wa Gadi nk’iragi, hakurikijwe abakuru b’inzu zigize uwo muryango.
Ibi ni vyo Mose yahaye igice c’umuryango wa Manase, ni ukuvuga igice c’abantu bakomoka kuri Manase ukurikije abakuru b’inzu ziwugize:
Intara iva i Mahanayimu, hakajamwo n’i Bashani hose, akarere kose k’umwami Ogi w’i Bashani, hamwe n’ibisagara mirongo itandatu vy’i Bashani vyatwarwa na Yayiro.

Bahawe kandi n’igice ca Gileyadi, n’ibisagara vya Ashitaroti na Edireyi, ibisagara vy’umwami Ogi i Bashani. Ivyo vyose ni vyo vyahawe uruvyaro rwa Makiri, mwene Manase ku bw’igice c’abahungu ba Makiri, ukurikije abakuru b’ingo zigize uwo muryango.
Izo ni zo ntara Mose yatanze nk’iragi igihe yari mu kiyaya c’i Mowabu hafi y’uruzi Yorodani mu buseruko bwa Yeriko.
Ariko umuryango wa Lewi nta ragi Mose yawuhaye, kuko Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli ari we ragi ryabo, nk’uko yabibasezeraniye.

headings.text: Bagaburirwa igice co mu buseruko bwa Yorodani

verses.text: Izi ni zo ntara imiryango y’Abisirayeli yari isigaye yahawe nk’iragi ryabo mu gihugu c’i Kanani, bahagaburiwe n’umuherezi Eliyazeri, ari kumwe na Yosuwa mwene Nuni, n’abakuru b’imiryango ya Isirayeli.
Imiryango icenda n’igice ni yo yahawe intara hakoreshejwe ubupfindo nk’uko Uhoraho yari yarabitegetse aciye kuri Mose.
Mose yari yaramaze gutanga iragi ku miryango ibiri n’igice ayiha mu buseruko bwa Yorodani ariko Abalewi nta ragi na rimwe bahawe nk’iyindi miryango.
Abahungu babiri ba Yosefu bavuyemwo imiryango ibiri ari yo Manase na Efurayimu. Abalewi nta mugabane w’intara baronse ariko bahawe ibisagara vyo kubamwo, hamwe n’uburagiro bw’ibitungwa vyabo.
Nuko Abisirayeli bagaburirwa ico gihugu nk’uko Uhoraho yari yarabitegetse Mose.

Umusi umwe abantu bo mu muryango wa Yuda bagendera Yosuwa i Gilugali, barongowe na Kalebu mwene Yefune w’Umukenizi. Kalebu abarira Yosuwa ati: “Wibuke ivyo Uhoraho yabwiye Mose umusavyi w’Imana kuri wewe nanje igihe twari i Kadeshi Baruneya.
Nari mfise imyaka mirongo ine igihe Mose umusavyi w’ Uhoraho yandungika gutata iki gihugu mva i Kadeshi Baruneya. Namubwiye inkuru nkurikije uko navyumva mu mutima,
mugabo benewacu twaduganye batumye imitima y’abantu iranduka kubera ubwoba. Ariko jewe nakurikiye Uhoraho Imana yanje n’umutima wanje wose.
Uwo musi rero, Mose yararahiye ati: ‘Aho ibirenge vyawe vyahonyoye muri ico gihugu hazoba iragi ryawe n’uruvyaro rwawe ibihe vyose, kuko wakurikiye Uhoraho Imana yanje n’umutima wawe wose.’

None rero, nk’uko Uhoraho yabinsezeraniye, yarazigamye ubugingo bwanje imyaka mirongo ine n’itanu kuva igihe yabwira Mose ivyo, igihe Abisirayeli bariko barayerera mu bugaragwa. Uyu musi maze imyaka mirongo umunani n’itanu.
Ndacafise inkomezi nk’izo nari mfise igihe Mose yandungika, kandi ndacaja mu ntambara nk’uko nari meze ico gihe.

None rero ndasavye umpe iki gihugu c’imisozi miremire nk’uko Uhoraho yabinsezeraniye uwo musi. Na wewe nyene wariyumviye ko Abanaki ari bo bahaba kandi ko n’ibisagara vyabo bizitiriwe cane. Ariko Uhoraho niyabana nanje nzobirukana nk’uko yabivuze.”
Maze Yosuwa ahezagira Kalebu mwene Yefune, amuha Heburoni nk’iragi ryiwe.
Nuko Heburoni hegukira Kalebu mwene Yefune Umukenizi kuva ico gihe, kuko yubashe Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli n’umutima wiwe wose.
Heburoni hahora hitwa Kiriyati-Araba. Hiswe uko kubera Araba, umuhizi yakomoka kuri Anaki. Maze iyo ntara iraruhuka intambara iba amahoro.

headings.text: Bagabura igihugu co mu burengero bwa Yorodani

verses.text: Intara yahawe umuryango wa Yuda, ukurikije abakuru b’inzu zigize uwo muryango, yaramanuka igashika ku ntara y’abakomoka kuri Edomu ikabandanya gushika mu bugaragwa bw’i Zini kure cane uja mu bumanuko.
Urubibe rwaho rwo mu bumanuko rwava ku Kiyaga c’Umunyu,

rugaca mu bumanuko bw’ahitwa Akurabimu, rukabandanya gushika i Zini, rukarenga no mu bumanuko bwa Kadeshi Baruneya rugashika i Hezironi hanyuma rukaduga gushika Adari, rugaca ruzunguruka ruja i Karuka.
Kuva aho rugaca rurengana Azimoni rugashika ku kagezi ka Egiputa, kisuka mu Kiyaga Mediterane. Urwo ni rwo rubibe rwabo rw’amaja mu bumanuko.

Urubibe rwo mu buseruko rwava ku Kiyaga c’Umunyu rugashika aho Yorodani rwisukira muri ico kiyaga. Amaja mu buraruko na ho rwava kw’isonga ry’ikiyaga rugashika aho Yorodani rwisukira muri ico kiyaga c’umunyu,
rukaduga rukaja i Beti-Hogila rukabandanya mu buraruko bwa Beti-Araba rugashika kw’ibuye rya Bohani, mwene Reyubeni.

Uvuye ngaho, urwo rubibe ruca ruduga i Debiri hanyuma ruvuye mu kiyaya ca Akori rugaca rukevya rukaja mu buraruko bwa Gilugali aharabana na Adumimu mu bumanuko bw’ikiyaya. Rugaca rubandanya ruja ku mazi ya Eni-Shemeshi rugashika kuri Eni-Rogeli.

Maze rugaca ruduga ruciye mu kiyaya ca Beni-Hinomu rukagenda rukika hepfo y’imimanuko iri ahari igisagara c’Abayebusi ari co Yerusalemu. Kuva aho rugaca ruduga ku mitwe y’imisozi, n’ikiyaya ca Beni-Hinomu mu buraruko bw’ikiyaya ca Refayimu.
Ruvuye kuri iyo misozi, urwo rubibe ruca ruhindukira rukaja ku mariba y’i Nefutowa, rugaserukira mu bisagara vyo ku musozi Efuroni, hanyuma rukamanuka ruja i Bayala, ari ho i Kiriyati-Yeyarimu.
Ruca ruhindukira ruva mu burengero bwa Bayala ruja ku musozi Seyiri, rugaca ku mimanuko y’umusozi Yeyarimu ari ho Kesalini, rukabandanya rumanuka gushika i Beti-Shemeshi rukajabuka ruja i Timuna.
Ruca rubandanya rugaca mu buraruko bw’imimanuko ya Ekuroni, rugahindukira rukaraba i Shikeroni, rugaca ku musozi Bayala rugashika i Yabuneli. Urwo rubibe rukagarukira ku Kiyaga Mediterane.
Urubibe rwo mu burengero ni aho Ikiyaga Mediterane kigarukira. Izo ni zo mbibe z’imiryango ya Yuda.
Akurikije uko Uhoraho yamutegetse, Yosuwa yahaye Kalebu mwene Yefune igice c’itongo mu mugabane wa Yuda, aho ni Kiriyati-Araba, ari ho Heburoni, hari hiswe iryo zina Araba kubera sekuruza w’Abanaki.
Nuko i Heburoni, Kalebu ahirukana imigwi itatu y’Abanaki ari bo ruvyaro rwa Sheshayi, urwa Ahimani n’urwa Talumayi, bene Anaki.
Avuye aho aca aja gutera abantu baba i Debiri ahahora hitwa Kiriyati-Seferi.
Maze Kalebu aravuga ati: “Uwuzotera i Kiriyati-Seferi akahafata, nzomuha umukobwa wanje Akisa abe umugore wiwe.”
Otiniyeli mwene Kenazi, avukana na Kalebu, arahafata; Kalebu aca amushingira umukobwa wiwe Akisa.
Akisa amaze kuba umugore wa Otiniyeli, aca amubwira ngo asabe se itongo. Akisa yururutse indogoba yiwe, Kalebu aramubaza ati: “Wipfuza iki?”
Akisa amwishura ati: “Ngirira ubuntu. Ko wampaye itongo i Negebu, mpa n’amariba y’amazi.” Nuko Kalebu amuha amariba yo hepfo n’ayo haruguru.
Iri ni ryo ragi ry’umuryango wa Yuda, ukurikije uko abakuru b’inzu ziwugize zimeze:
Ibisagara vy’epfo cane mu bumanuko vy’umuryango wa Yuda mu gice citwa Negebu amaja ku rubibe rwa Edomu vyari ibi: Kabuzeyeli, Ederi, Yaguri,
Kinahi, Dimonahi, Adadahi,
Kedeshi, Hazori, Itinani,
Zifu, Telemu, Beyaloti,
Hazori-Hadata, Keriyoti Hezironi ari co Hazori,
Amamu, Shema, Molada,
Hazari-Gadahi, Heshimoni, Beti-Peleti,
Hazari-Shuwali, Berisheba, Biziyotiya,
Bayala, Iyimu, Ezemu,
Elitoladi, Kesili, Horuma,
Zikulagi, Madumana, Sansanahi,
Lebiti, Shilihimu, Ayini na Rimoni. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara mirongo ibiri n’icenda, biri kumwe n’imihana yavyo.
Mu biyaya vyo mu burengero hari: Eshitayoli, Zora, Ashina,
Zanowa, Eni-Ganimu, Tapuwa, Enamu,
Yarimuti, Adulamu, Soko, Azeka,
Shayarayimu, Aditayimu na Gedera canke Gederotayimu. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara icumi na bine n’imihana yari ibikikuje.
Zanani, Hadasha, Migidali-Gadi,
Dileyani, Misipehi, Yokiteheli,
Lakishi, Bozikati, Eguloni,
Gaboni, Lahamasi, Kitilishi,
Gederoti, Beti-Dagoni, Nama na Makeda, vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara icumi na bitandatu, biri kumwe n’imihana yari ibikikuje.
Libuna, Etiheri, Ashani,
Ifuta, Ashina, Nezibu,
Keyila, Akizibu na Maresha, vyose uko ari ibisagara icenda hamwe n’imihana yari ibikikuje.
Igisagara Ekuroni n’ivyagikomokako vyose, n’imihana yaco yose,
Ibisagara vyose vyo mu ntara ya Ashidodi, mu burengero bwa Ekuroni, n’imihana yaho yose.
Ashidodi, n’imihana ihakikuje, Gaza n’imihana yaho, gushika ku kagezi ka Egiputa, n’inkengera z’ikiyaga Mediterane.
Mu ntara igizwe n’imitumba miremire hari: Shamiri, Yatiri, Soko,
Dana, Kiriyati-Sanahi ari yo Debiri,
Anabu, Eshitemo, Animu,
Gosheni, Holoni na Gilo. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara icumi na bibiri, n’imihana yari ibikikuje.
Araba, Duma, Eshani,
Yanimu, Beti-Tapuwa, Afeka,
Humuta, Kiriyati-Araba ari yo Heburoni, na Ziyori. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara icenda, n’imihana yari ibikikuje.
Mayoni, Karumeli, Zifu, Yuta,
Yezireyeli, Yokodiyamu, Zanowa,
Kayini, Gibeya na Timuna. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara icumi, n’imihana yari ibikikuje yose.
Halihuli, Beti-Zuri, Gedori,
Mayarati, Beti-Anoti, na Elitekoni. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara bitandatu n’imihana yavyo yose.
Kiriyati-Bayali ari co Kiriyati-Yeyarimu na Raba. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara bibiri n’imihana yari ibikikuje yose.
Mu bugaragwa hari: Beti-Araba, Midini, Sekaka,
Nibushani, Igisagara c’Umunyu, hamwe na Eni-Gedi. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara bitandatu n’imihana yari ibikikuje.
Ariko umuryango wa Yuda ntiwashoboye kwirukana Abayebusi baba mu gisagara ca Yerusalemu, ari na co gituma gushika n’uwu musi Abayebusi bakibana n’Abayuda.
Itongo ryahawe uruvyaro rwa Yosefu ryava kuri Yorodani, mu buseruko bw’amariba y’i Yeriko, rugaca mu bugaragwa mu ntara irimwo imisozi miremire ya Beteli.
Ruvuye i Beteli ari ho i Luzi, rwaca rujabuka rukaja mu ntara y’Abaruki muri Ataroti,
rukamanuka ruja mu burengero mu ntara y’Abafuleti rugashika mu ntara ya Beti-Horoni mu bumanuko, rukabandanya n’i Gezeri, rugashika ku Kiyaga Mediterane.
Iryo ni ryo tongo ryahawe imiryango y’abahungu ba Yosefu, ari bo Manase na Efurayimu.
Aha ni ho Efurayimu yahawe, ukurikije abakuru b’inzu zigize uwo muryango: Urubibe rw’umugabane bahawe rwava muri Ataroti Adari mu buseruko kuduga kugeza ruguru i Beti-Horoni,
rukabandanya kugeza ku Kiyaga Mediterane. Ruvuye i Mikimetati mu buraruko, rwaca ruhindukira rukaja mu buseruko ahitwa Tanati Shilo, ruciye mu buseruko bwa Yanowa.
Hanyuma rwaca rumanuka ruva i Yanowa ruja i Ataroti n’i Nayara, rugaca i Yeriko rugashika kuri Yorodani.
Ruvuye i Tapuwa, rwaca ruja mu burengero kw’isumo ry’i Kana rugashika ku Kiyaga Mediterane. Iryo ni ryo ragi umuryango w’Abefurayimu wahawe ukurikije abakuru b’inzu zigize uwo muryango.
Bari bahawe kandi n’ibisagara vyose n’imihana yari ibikikuje vyari vyabikiwe Abefurayimu mu mugabane w’abo kwa Manase.
Ntibirukanye Abanyakanani baba i Gezeri, gushika n’ubu Abanyakanani baracabana n’Abefurayimu, ariko babakorera nk’abaja.
Iyi ni yo ntara yahawe umuryango wa Manase imfura ya Yosefu. Makiri, imfura ya Manase ari we sekuruza w’Abagileyadi, yahawe Gileyadi na Bashani, kuko Abagileyadi bari abahizi mu ntambara.

Aho hantu baronse hari hagenewe ikindi gice c’uwo muryango wa Manase; ugizwe n’abakuru b’inzu zo mu muryango ari bo: Abiyezeri, Heleki, Asiriyeli, Shekemu, Heferi na Shemida. Abo ni abandi bagabo bakomoka kuri Manase umuhungu wa Yosefu, ukurikije inzu baserukira.

Ico gihe Zelofehadi mwene Heferi, Heferi mwene Gileyadi, Gileyadi mwene Makiri, Makiri mwene Manase, ntiyari yaravyaye abahungu, yari yavyaye abakobwa gusa. Na bo bari aba: Mahala, Nowa, Hogula, Milika na Tiriza.

Maze baragenda babwira umuherezi Eliyazeri, Yosuwa mwene Nuni, n’abatware, bati: “ Uhoraho yategetse Mose kuduha iragi muri benewacu.” Nuko Yosuwa aca abaha iragi co kimwe na benewabo, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yarabitegetse.
Iragi rya Manase ryose hamwe ryangana n’amatongo icumi, hongeweko n’amatongo ya Gileyadi na Bashani mu buseruko bwa Yorodani,
kuko abakobwa bo mu ruvyaro rwa Manase baronse itongo co kimwe na basaza babo. Itongo ry’i Gileyadi ryaciye ritwarwa n’uruvyaro rwa Manase rwari rusigaye.
Intara Manase yahawe yava kwa Asheri igashika kwa Mikimetati, mu buseruko bwa Shekemu. Urubibe ruvuye aho rwashika mu bumanuko harimwo n’ahaba abantu b’i Eni-Tapuwa.
Intara ikikuje igisagara ca Tapuwa yaganzwa n’Abamanase, ariko ico gisagara ubwaco kikaba cari ku rubibe rw’intara ya Manase kandi cegukira Abefurayimu.

Hanyuma urwo rubibe rwaca rubandanya rugashika kw’isumo ry’i Kana. Aho hari ibisagara vya Efurayimu vyari kumwe n’ivya Manase, ariko urubibe rwa Manase rwari haruguru y’iryo sumo rugashika ku Kiyaga Mediterane.

Mu bumanuko, iyo ntara yari iya Efurayimu, mu buraruko ikaba iya Manase. Intara ya Manase yashika ku Kiyaga Mediterane, ikongera igahana urubibe n’intara ya Asheri mu buraruko, n’iya Isakari mu buseruko.
Mu ntara zahawe Isakari na Asheri, harimwo kandi n’ibisagara vyahawe Manase. Na vyo ni: Beti-Shani, Ibileyamu hamwe n’ababa i Dori, Eni-Dori, Tanaki na Megido, hamwe n’abari bahakikuje.
Ariko uruvyaro rwa Manase ntirwashoboye gufata ivyo bisagara, kuko Abanyakanani bagumye bahaba.
Ariko Abisirayeli bamaze kugwira bagakomera, baciye bagira Abanyakanani abagurano babo, ariko ntibabirukana bose.
Uruvyaro rwa Yosefu rubwira Yosuwa ruti: “Ni kubera iki waduhaye intara imwe nk’iragi turi benshi, kandi Uhoraho yaraduhezagiye cane?”
Yosuwa arabishura ati: “Nimba muri benshi, kandi intara y’imisozi miremire ya Efurayimu ikaba itabakwiye, nimuduge mu kibira mwiyagurire amatongo mu gihugu c’Abaperizi n’Abarefayimu.”

Uruvyaro rwa Yosefu rumwishura ruti: “Igihugu c’imisozi ntikidukwiye kandi Abanyakanani baba mu kiyaya bafise imikogote y’ivyuma, co kimwe n’ababa i Beti-Shani n’abahakikuje hamwe n’abo mu kiyaya c’i Yezireyeli.”
Ariko Yosuwa abwira imiryango ya Yosefu ari bo Manase na Efurayimu ati: “Muri benshi kandi murakomeye. Ntimuzoronka intara imwe gusa

ahubwo muzohabwa n’ikibira kiri mu misozi miremire na co nyene. Genda mugitunganye imbibe muzishikane kure aho mushaka, hazoba ahanyu. Naho Abanyakanani bafise imikogote y’ivyuma kandi bakaba bakomeye, muzobirukana.”
Abisirayeli bose bakoranira i Shilo haba ari ho bashinga Ihema ry’Ibonaniro, kandi ico gihugu cose cari gisigaye kiganzwa na bo.
Ariko hariho imiryango indwi y’Abisirayeli itari bwaronke iragi ryayo.
Nuko Yosuwa abarira Abisirayeli ati: “Mbega muzorindira gushika ryari kugira ngo mufate iki gihugu Uhoraho Imana ya ba sogokuruza yabahaye?
Nimuhitemwo abantu batatu batatu mu muryango wose, hanyuma ndabarungike kugendagenda ico gihugu, baheze bagire icegeranyo cereye iragi ryabo ryose hamwe, hanyuma bagaruke aho ndi.
Ico gihugu baze bakigaburemwo ibice indwi. Yuda azogume mu ntara yiwe mu bumanuko, Yosefu na we mu buraruko.
Nimwamara kwandika ico cegeranyo c’ivyo bice indwi, nzoheza ngirire ubupfindo imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yacu.

Ariko Abalewi bobo nta ntara bazotorana muri mwebwe, kuko igikorwa c’ubuherezi c’ Uhoraho ari ryo ragi ryabo. Kandi Gadi na Reyubeni n’igice c’umuryango wa Manase baramaze kuronka iragi ryabo mu buseruko bwa Yorodani. Mose umusavyi w’ Uhoraho yarahabahaye.”

Abantu bagira bave hasi ngo bagende kugira igicapo c’ico gihugu, Yosuwa arababwira ati: “Genda murabe neza ico gihugu, muheze mugire igicapo caco. Maze muzogaruke aho ndi, nzoheza nkoreshe ubupfindo ndi aha nyene i Shilo imbere y’ Uhoraho .”

Ba bantu baca baragenda, baca muri ca gihugu cose. Bagira igicapo caco kigabuyemwo ibice indwi, berekana n’ibisagara biri mu gice cose. Baca bagira icegeranyo baraheza bagaruka aho Yosuwa ari mw’ikambi i Shilo.
Yosuwa araheza akoresha ubupfindo i Shilo imbere y’ Uhoraho , araheza akigaburira Abisirayeli akurikije uko imiryango yabo iri.
Ubupfindo bwa mbere bwerekanye intara y’umuryango wa Benyamini n’abakuru b’inzu ziwugize. Yari hagati y’intara yahawe Yuda n’iyahawe Yosefu.
Mu buraruko, urubibe rw’intara yabo rutangurira ku ruzi Yorodani, rugaca haruguru y’imimanuko ya Yeriko, rukagenda rutumbereye mu burengero rugaca mu misozi miremire no mu bugaragwa bwa Beti-Aveni.
Ruvuye aho ruca ku mimanuko yo hepfo ya Luzi, ari yo Beteli, rukamanuka muri Atorati Adari, hepfo y’imisozi ya Beti-Horoni.

Ruvuye kuri iyo misozi irabana na Beti-Horoni mu bumanuko urwo rubibe ruca ruhindukira rukamanuka rukagenda rutumbereye mu burengero gushika i Kiriyati-Bayali, ari ho Kiriyati-Yeyarimu, igisagara c’Abayuda. Aho hari ku ruhande rw’amaja mu burengero.
Uruhande rwo mu bumanuko rutangurira hirya y’igisagara Kiriyati-Yeyarimu amaja mu burengero, rugaserukira ku mariba ya Nefutowa.

Urwo rubibe ruca rumanuka rugaca ku ntango y’imisozi irabana n’ikiyaya ca Beni-Hinomu, mu buraruko bw’ikiyaya ca Refayimu. Ruca rubandanya rukamanuka mu kiyaya ca Hinomu rugakikama musi y’imimanuko y’igisagara c’Abayebusi rugaca rushikira muri Eni-Rogeli.
Ruca ruhindukira rukaraba mu buraruko, rukaja muri Eni-Shemeshi rukabandanya i Geliloti, aharabana n’inzira ya Adumimu, rugaca rumanuka kw’ibuye rya Bohani mwene Reyubeni.
Ruca Rubandanya amaja mu buraruko ruciye ku mumanuko wa Beti-Araba rukabandanya rumanuka rugashika muri Araba.
Ruca ruduga rugaca haruguru y’umumanuko wa Beti-Hogila rugaserukira amaja mu buraruko bw’Ikiyaga c’Umunyu naho uruzi Yorodani rwisuka. Urwo ni rwo rwari urubibe rw’amaja mu bumanuko.
Yorodani ni rwo rwari urubibe rwo mu buseruko. Izo ni zo mbibe zerekana impande zose z’umugabane warazwe umuryango wa Benyamini ku mpande zose.
Umuryango wa Benyamini n’abakuru b’inzu ziwukomokako, wahawe ibisagara bikurikira: Yeriko, Beti-Hogila, Emeki Kezizi,
Beti-Araba Zemarayimu, Beteli,
Avimu, Para, Ofura,
Kefari-Amoni, Ofuni na Geba. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara icumi na bibiri hamwe n’imihana yari ibikikuje.
Hakabamwo na Gibeyoni, Rama, Beroti,
Misipehi, Kefira, Moza,
Rekemu, Iripeli, Tarala,
Zela, Hayelefu, Yebusi ari co Yerusalemu, Gibeya na Kiriyati. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara icumi na bine biri kumwe n’imihana yari ibikikuje Iryo ni ryo ryari iragi ry’umuryango wa Benyamini.
Ubupfindo bwa kabiri bwerekana intara y’umuryango wa Simeyoni, n’abakuru b’inzu zigize uwo muryango. Iragi ryabo ryari hagati mu ntara ya Yuda.
Ryari rigizwe n’ibisagara: Berisheba ari co Sheba, Molada,
Hazari-Shuwali, Bala, Ezemu,
Elitoladi, Betuli, Horuma,
Zikulagi, Beti-Marukaboti, Hazari-Susa,
Beti-Lebayoti na Sharuheni. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara icumi na bitatu n’imihana yari ibikikuje.
Harimwo Ayini, Rimoni, Eteri na Ashani. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara bine biri kumwe n’imihana yari ibikikuje,
hakabamwo kandi n’imihana yose yari ikikuje ivyo bisagara, gushika i Bayalati-Beyeri, ari ho Rama h’i Negebu. Iyo ntara ni yo yari umugabane w’umuryango wa Simeyoni.
Umugabane wa Simeyoni wagabanijwe ku mugabane wa Yuda kubera yuko intara ya Yuda yari nini kurenza iyo bakeneye. Uko ni ko umuryango wa Simeyoni waronse iragi ryawo hagati mu ntara ya Yuda.
Ubupfindo bwa gatatu bwerekana intara y’umuryango wa Zebuloni, n’abakuru b’inzu zigize uwo muryango. Urubibe rw’uwo mugabane rwashika i Saridi.
Rwava aho rukagenda rutumbereye mu burengero, rukarengana Marala rugashika kuri Dabesheti, rukabandanya gushika ku mugezi wo mu buseruko bwa Yokineyamu.
Ku rundi ruhande, rwava i Saridi rukaja mu buseruko mu ntara ya Kisiloti Tabori, rukabandanya gushika i Daberati rugashika i Yafiya.
Rwaca rubandanya ruja mu buseruko rugashika i Gati-Heferi no muri Eti-Kazini; rukava i Rimoni rugaca ruhindukira rukaraba i Neya.
Ruvuye aho rwaca rubandanya rukazunguruka mu buraruko ruja i Hanatoni rugashika mu kiyaya ca Ifutahi-Eli.
Ibisagara vyari muri iyo ntara vyari ibi: Kata, Nahalali, Shimuroni, Idala na Betelehemu. Vyari ibisagara icumi na bibiri biri kumwe n’imihana yari ibikikuje.
Ivyo bisagara n’iyo mihana ni vyo vyari iragi ry’umuryango wa Zebuloni, ukurikije abakuru b’inzu zigize uwo muryango.
Ubupfindo bwa kane bwerekanye intara y’umuryango wa Isakari, n’abakuru b’inzu zigize uwo muryango.
Iyo ntara yari ifise: Yezireyeli, Kesuloti, Shunemu,
Hafarayimu, Shiyoni, Anaharati,
Rabiti, kishiyoni, Ebezi,
Remeti, Eni-Ganimu, Eni-Hada, na Beti-Pazezi.
Urwo rubibe rwarashika no kuri Tabori, Shahazuma na Beti-Shemeshi, rukagarukira kuri Yorodani. Vyari ibisagara icumi na bitandatu n’imihana yari ibikikuje.
Ivyo bisagara n’imihana ibikikuje ni vyo vyari umugabane w’umuryango wa Isakari.
Ubupfindo bwa gatanu bwerekanye intara y’umuryango wa Asheri, n’abakuru b’inzu zigize uwo muryango.
Iyo ntara yarimwo: Helikati, Hali, Beteni, Akishafu,
Alameleki, Amadi na Mishali. Mu burengero, urubibe rwaca kuri Karumeli na Shihori-Libunati.
Rwaca ruhindukira rukaraba mu buseruko amaja i Beti-Dagoni, rugashikira Zebuloni n’ikiyaya ca Ifutahi-Eli, rugaca ruja mu buraruko i Beti-Emeki n’i Neyiyeli, hanyuma rugaca i buryo bwa Kabuli.
Rwaca rubandanya ruja muri Abudoni, i Rehobu, i Hamoni n’i Kana, rugashika i Sidoni, igisagara kinini.
Rwaca ruhindukira rukaraba i Rama, rukaja ku gisagara kizitiye cane c’i Tiro, rugahindukira ruraba i Hosa, rukaja ku Kiyaga Mediterane mu ntara ya Akizibu,
Uma, na Efeki, na Rehobu. Hari ibisagara mirongo ibiri na bibiri hamwe n’imihana yari ibikikuje.
Ivyo bisagara n’iyo mihana ni vyo vyahawe umuryango wa Asheri nk’iragi, hakurikijwe abakuru b’inzu ziwugize.
Ubupfindo bwa gatandatu, bwerekanye intara yegukira umuryango wa Nafutali, hakurikijwe abakuru b’inzu ziwugize.
Urubibe rwawo rwava i Helefu, kuva ku giti kinini i Zayananimu, rugaca muri Adami Nekebu na Yabuneli ruja i Lakumu rukagarukira kuri Yorodani.
Mu burengero urwo rubibe rwaca kuri Azinoti Tabori rugashika kuri Hukoki. Mu bumanuko rwaca kwa Zebuloni, Asheri akaba mu burengero, nayo Yuda akaba mu buseruko kuri Yorodani.
Ibisagara vyari bizitiriwe vyari ibi: Zidimu, Zeri, Hamati, Rekati, Kinereti,
Adama, Rama, Hazori,
Kedeshi, Edireyi, Eni-Hazori,
Yironi, Migidali-Eli, Horemu, Beti-Anati na Beti-Shemeshi. Vyari ibisagara icumi n’icenda hamwe n’imihana yose yari ibikikuje.
Ivyo ni vyo bisagara vyahawe umuryango wa Nafutali nk’iragi ryabo, ukurikije inzu zawo.
Ubupfindo bw’indwi bwerekanye intara ibaye iy’umuryango wa Dani hakurikijwe abakuru b’inzu zigize uwo muryango.
Intara bahawe yarimwo ibisagara bikurikira: Zora, Eshitayoli, Iri-Shemashi,
Shayalabini, Ayaloni, Itahila,
Eloni, Timuna, Ekuroni,
Eliteke, Gibetoni, Bayalati,
Yehudi, Beni-Beraki, Gati-Rimoni,
Me Yarikoni na Rakoni, hamwe n’aharabana n’i Yopa.
Ariko ab’umuryango wa Dani ntivyaboroheye gufata intara yabo, ni ko kuduga bagatera Leshemu, bakahafata, bakamarisha inkota abahaba bose. Baca baba i Leshemu, bahita Dani, izina rya sekuruza wabo.
Ivyo ni vyo bisagara n’imihana ibikikuje vyahawe umuryango wa Dani nk’iragi ryabo, hakurikijwe abakuru b’inzu zigize uwo muryango.
Iyo miryango yose ihejeje kugabangana igihugu, Abisirayeli baca baha Yosuwa mwene Nuni itongo mu yabo.
Nk’uko Uhoraho yari yarabitegetse, bamuha igisagara yabasavye ari co Timunati-Sera cari mu ntara y’imisozi miremire ya Efurayimu. Aca asubiramwo kwubaka ico gisagara, aba ari ho aba.

Izo ni zo ntara umuherezi Eliyazeri, Yosuwa mwene Nuni hamwe n’abakuru barongoye imiryango y’Abisirayeli bagaburiye imiryango yose nk’imigabane bari i Shilo hakoreshejwe ubupfindo, bari imbere y’ Uhoraho mu rwinjiriro rw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro. Igikorwa co kugabura ico gihugu kiba kirarangiye.
Maze Uhoraho abarira Yosuwa ati:
“Barira Abisirayeli bategekanye ibisagara vy’ubuhungiro, nk’uko nabibategetse nciye kuri Mose,
kugira ngo nihagira uwica umuntu atabishaka canke atabiteguye, azoshobore kuronka aho ahungira uwuzoba ajejwe guhora amaraso mu muryango w’uwapfuye.
Niyamara guhungira muri kimwe muri ivyo bisagara, azohagarare kw’irembo ryaco yiregure ku bakuru baco. Bazoheze bamwakire muri ico gisagara, bamuhe aho aba, abane na bo.
Uwujejwe guhora amaraso niyamukurikirana, ntibaze bamutange, kuko azoba yishe mugenziwe atabishaka, atahora ari umwansi wiwe.
Azogume muri ico gisagara gushika yumvirijwe n’ikoraniro, yongere arindire gushika umuherezi mukuru azoba ariho ico gihe apfuye. Ni ho azoheza agasubira mu gisagara ciwe, ico yari yahunze avamwo.”
Nuko baca bategekanya Kedeshi i Galilaya mu misozi iri mu ntara ya Nafutali, Shekemu mu misozi iri mu ntara ya Efurayimu, na Kiriyati-Araba ari co Heburoni, mu misozi iri mu ntara ya Yuda.

Mu buseruko bwa Yorodani ahaherereye i Yeriko, bategekanya Bezeri mu bugaragwa no mu misozi migufimigufi mu muryango wa Reyubeni, Ramoti i Gileyadi mu muryango wa Gadi, n’i Golani i Bashani mu muryango wa Manase.

Umwisirayeli wese canke umunyamahanga yabana n’Abisirayeli yishe umuntu atabishaka yaca ahungira muri ivyo bisagara vyateguriwe ico kugira ngo uwujejwe guhora amaraso y’umuryango ntahave amwica ataraburana imbere y’ikoraniro.
Abakuru b’umuryango w’Abalewi begera umuherezi Eliyazeri, na Yosuwa mwene Nuni, hamwe n’abakuru b’iyindi miryango ya Isirayeli,
bari i Shilo mu gihugu c’i Kanani, bababwira bati: “ Uhoraho yategetse Mose ko muzoduha ibisagara tubamwo, n’uburagiro bw’ibitungwa vyacu.”
Nuko, nk’uko Uhoraho yabitegetse, Abisirayeli baca baha Abalewi ibisagara n’uburagiro bikurikira nk’iragi ryabo:

Ubupfindo bwa mbere bwerekana umuryango wa bene Kohati hakurikijwe abakuru b’inzu ziwugize. Abalewi bakomoka kuri Aroni umuherezi bahabwa ibisagara icumi na bitatu mu vyari vyahawe Yuda, Simeyoni na Benyamini.
Abo mu ruvyaro rwa Kohati bari basigaye bahabwa nk’imigabane yabo ibisagara icumi mu vyari vyahawe imiryango ya Efurayimu, Dani, n’igice c’umuryango wa Manase.
Abo mu ruvyaro rwa Gerishoni bahawe nk’imigabane yabo ibisagara icumi na bitatu mu vyari vyahawe imiryango ya Isakari, Asheri, Nafutali, n’igice c’umuryango wa Manase w’i Bashani.
Abo mu ruvyaro rwa Merari bahabwa ibisagara icumi na bibiri mu vyari vyahawe imiryango ya Reyubeni, Gadi na Zebuloni.
Nuko Abisirayeli bashitsa ivyo Uhoraho yategetse Mose, mu guha Abalewi ibisagara n’uburagiro bwavyo nk’uko ubupfindo bwagiye buravyerekana.
Bahawe ibisagara n’amazina yavyo mu miryango ya Yuda na Simeyoni.
Aya ni yo mazina y’ibisagara vyahawe uruvyaro rwa Aroni, bakomoka ku nzu ya Kohati Umulewi kuko ubupfindo ari bo bwerekanye ubwa mbere:
Kiriyati-Araba ari ho Heburoni, mu misozi miremire ya Yuda, hamwe n’uburagiro buhakikuje. Araba yari sekuruza wa Anaki.
Ariko imirima n’imihana yari ikikuje ico gisagara vyari vyahawe Kalebu mwene Yefune nk’iragi ryiwe.
Ibisagara bikurikira hamwe n’uburagiro bwavyo ni vyo vyahawe uruvyaro rw’umuherezi Aroni: Heburoni, igisagara c’ubuhungiro ku wishe umuntu atabishaka, Libuna,
Yatiri, Eshitemowa,
Holoni, Debiri,
Ayini, Yuta na Beti-Shemeshi. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara icenda n’uburagiro bwavyo, ni vyo bahawe muri iyi miryango ibiri.
Ibisagara vyo mu muryango wa Benyamini babahaye ni: Gibeyoni, Geba,
Anatoti na Alumoni. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara bine n’uburagiro bwavyo.
Ibisagara vyahawe abaherezi, ari rwo ruvyaro rwa Aroni, biri kumwe n’uburagiro bwavyo, vyose hamwe vyari icumi na bitatu.
Abakohati bari basigaye bo mu muryango wa Lewi bahawe nk’imigabane ibisagara bikurikira mu muryango wa Efurayimu:
Mu misozi miremire ya Efurayimu bahahawe: Shekemu, igisagara c’ubuhungiro ku wishe umuntu atabishaka; hamwe na Gezeri,
Kibuzayimu na Beti-Horoni. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara bine biri kumwe n’uburagiro bwavyo.
Ibisagara bikurikira n’uburagiro bwavyo ni vyo abaherezi bahawe mu muryango wa Dani: Eliteke, Gibetoni,
Ayaloni na Gati-Rimoni. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara bine, biri kumwe n’uburagiro bwavyo.
Mu gice c’umuryango wa Manase bahahawe: Tanaki na Gati-Rimoni, n’uburagiro bwavyo. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara bibiri.
Ibisagara vyose hamwe vyahawe imiryango ya Kohati yari yasigaye vyari icumi n’uburagiro bwavyo.

Uruvyaro rwa Gerishoni, iyindi nzu yo mu muryango w’Abalewi, rwahawe ibisagara bikurikira n’uburagiro bwavyo: mu gice c’umuryango wa Manase: Golani kiri muri Bashani; igisagara c’ubuhungiro ku wishe umuntu atabishaka, na Beshitera, n’uburagiro bwavyo. Vyari ibisagara bibiri.
Mu muryango wa Isakari, bahahawe ibisagara bikurikira biri kumwe n’uburagiro bwavyo: Kishiyoni, Daberati,
Yarimuti na Eni-Ganimu. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara bine n’uburagiro bwavyo.
Mu muryango wa Asheri, bahahawe ibisagara bikurikira biri kumwe n’uburagiro bwavyo: Mishali, Abudoni,
Helikati na Rehobu. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara bine n’uburagiro bwavyo.

Mu muryango wa Nafutali bahawe ibisagara bikurikira biri kumwe n’uburagiro bwavyo: Kedeshi muri Galilaya; igisagara c’ubuhungiro ku wishe umuntu atabishaka, Hamoti-Dori na Karitani. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara bitatu biri kumwe n’uburagiro bwavyo.
Ibisagara vyose hamwe vyahawe imiryango y’Abagerishoni biri kumwe n’uburagiro bwavyo vyari icumi na bitatu.
Abalewi bari bagisigaye, ari bo b’Abamerari bahawe ibisagara bikurikira n’uburagiro bwavyo: mu muryango wa Zebuloni: Yokineyamu, Karuta,
Dimina na Nahalali. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara bine, n’uburagiro bwavyo.
Mu muryango wa Reyubeni baronse ibisagara bikurikira biri kumwe n’uburagiro bwavyo: Bezeri, Yahiza,
Kedemoti na Mefayati. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara bine.
Mu muryango wa Gadi bahawe ibisagara bikurikira biri kumwe n’uburagiro bwavyo: Ramoti c’i Gileyadi; igisagara c’ubuhungiro ku wishe umuntu atabishaka, Mahanayimu,
Heshiboni na Yazeri. Vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara bine.
Ibisagara vyose vyahawe nk’imigabane imiryango y’Abalewi bo mu nzu ya bene Merari vyari icumi na bibiri.
Ibisagara vyahawe Abalewi mu gihugu cari cafashwe n’Abisirayeli vyari mirongo ine n’umunani, biri kumwe n’uburagiro bwavyo.
Igisagara kimwekimwe cose muri ivyo caba gifise uburagiro bugikikuje.
Nuko Uhoraho aha Isirayeli igihugu yari yararahiye ko azogiha ba sekuruza, baragifata kiba icabo, bakibamwo.
Uhoraho abaha akaruhuko aho bari hose, nk’uko yari yarabirahiye ba sekuruza babo. Nta mwansi wabo n’umwe yashoboye kubahagarara imbere, Uhoraho yagumye atanga abansi babo mu maboko yabo.
Nta sezerano ryiza na rimwe Uhoraho yari yarasezeraniye Isirayeli ritashitse; ivyo yasezeranye vyose yarabishikijije.
Ico gihe Yosuwa akoranya abo mu muryango wa Reyubeni n’uwa Gadi, hamwe n’igice c’uwa Manase
ababwira ati: “Mwashikije ivyo Mose umusavyi w’ Uhoraho yabategetse vyose, kandi nanje mwaranyumviye mu vyo nabategetse vyose.
Kuko uhereye kera gushika n’ubu, mutigeze mutana urugamba benewanyu, ahubwo mwabandanije igikorwa Uhoraho Imana yanyu yabashinze.
None rero ko Uhoraho Imana yanyu ahaye akaruhuko benewanyu nk’uko yabisezeranye, nimwisubirire iwanyu, mu ntara Mose umusavyi w’ Uhoraho yabahaye mu buseruko bwa Yorodani.

Ariko muzokwame mwiyubara, mukurikize amabwirizwa n’ivyagezwe Mose umusavyi w’ Uhoraho yabahaye: Mukunde Uhoraho Imana yanyu, mugendere mu nzira ziwe, mushitse amabwirizwa yiwe, mwumire kuri we, kandi mumukorere n’imitima yanyu yose, n’imishaha yanyu yose.”
Nuko Yosuwa arabahezagira, arabarungika, basubira iwabo.

Igice kimwe c’umuryango wa Manase Mose yari yagihaye intara ya Bashani mu buseruko bwa Yorodani, ikindi gice Yosuwa yagihaye intara yo mu burengero bwa Yorodani. Igihe Yosuwa yariko arabarungika, yarabahezagiye,
ababwira ati: “Nimusubire iwanyu mutwaye n’ubutunzi bwinshi mwanyaze abansi banyu: ibitungwa, ifeza, inzahabu, imyakaka, ivyuma, n’ivyambarwa vyinshi. Muzobigabure na benewanyu.”

Abo mu muryango wa Reyubeni n’uwa Gadi hamwe n’igice c’uwa Manase baca batandukanira n’abandi Bisirayeli i Shilo mu ntara ya Kanani, basubira i Gileyadi, mu ntara bahawe nk’uko Uhoraho yari yarabitegetse abicishije kuri Mose.
Bageze i Geliloti hafi ya Yorodani mu gihugu c’i Kanani, abo mu muryango wa Reyubeni n’uwa Gadi, n’ab’igice c’umuryango wa Manase baca bubaka igicaniro gisumba ibindi vyose.
Abandi Bisirayeli bumvise ko umuryango wa Reyubeni n’uwa Gadi hamwe n’ab’igice c’umuryango wa Manase bubatse igicaniro ku rubibe rwa Kanani i Geliloti hafi ya Yorodani ku ruhande rwa Isirayeli,
bose baca bakoranira i Shilo kugira ngo baje kubatera.
Abisirayeli baca barungika Finehasi mwene Eliyazeri umuherezi, aja i Gileyadi mu miryango ya Reyubeni na Gadi n’igice c’umuryango wa Manase.
Bamurungikana n’abagabo icumi b’abatware, umwumwe ku muryango, hamwe n’umukuru umwemwe ku muce wose wo mu miryango ya Isirayeli.
Bashitse i Gileyadi, babarira imiryango ya Reyubeni na Gadi n’igice c’umuryango wa Manase bati:
“Ikoraniro ryose ry’ Uhoraho rigize riti: ‘Ni kubera iki muhemukiye Imana ya Isirayeli ukwo? Ni iki catumye muva k’ Uhoraho mukamugarariza mu kwiyubakira igicaniro?
