Mbega icaha c’i Peyori nticari kimaze kuri twebwe? Gushika n’uwu musi ntituriyeza uko bikwiye, mbere n’inyuma y’uko ikiza caje ku bwoko bw’ Uhoraho !
Mbega murahevye Uhoraho ? Nimwagarariza Uhoraho uwu musi, ejo Uhoraho azorakira Abisirayeli bose.

Nimwakenera aho mwubaka igicaniro kubera intara yanyu ihumanye, muzoze mwifatanye natwe mu ntara y’ Uhoraho ahari ihema ry’ibonaniro ry’ Uhoraho , mubane natwe. Ariko ntimugararize Uhoraho mu kwubaka ikindi gicaniro atari ca gicaniro c’ Uhoraho Imana yacu.
Mbega igihe Akani mwene Zera yakora icaha mu kwiba ivyari vyagenewe kuba ivy’ Uhoraho , uburake bw’Imana ntibwaziriringiye Abisirayeli bose? Si we wenyene yapfuye azize ico caha.’ ”
Abo mu muryango wa Reyubeni n’uwa Gadi hamwe n’ab’igice c’umuryango wa Manase bishura abakuru b’imiryango y’Abisirayeli bati:

“ Uhoraho , Imana Ihambaye, ni we Mana wenyene! Uhoraho , Imana Ihambaye, ni we Mana wenyene! Ni yo izi ukuri, kandi n’Abisirayeli na bo nibakumenye. Iki gicaniro ntitwacubatse mu kugarariza Uhoraho . Nimba twacubatse mu bugarariji n’ukutumvira, Imana ntitureke ngo tubeho.
Nimba twubatse igicaniro cacu kugira ngo tuve k’ Uhoraho , ngo tugishikanireko ibimazi vyo guturirwa, hamwe n’amashikanwa y’ifu canke amashikanwa y’ishimwe, Uhoraho arabiduharurako.
Haba na mba! Icatumye tucubaka ni ukugira ngo uruvyaro rwanyu ntiruzohave rubwira uruvyaro rwacu ruti: ‘Mbega mwebwe Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli muyisenga nka ba nde?
Ko Uhoraho yashize hagati yacu uruzi Yorodani, mwebwe Abareyubeni n’Abagadi, nta co mupfana n’ Uhoraho .’ Gutyo uruvyaro rwanyu rugatuma urwacu ruheba gutinya Uhoraho .
Ni co catumye twibwira tuti: ‘Reka twubake igicaniro, ariko ntitugitangireko ibimazi.’

Twashaka ko kiba icibutso gusa. Kizokwibutse uruvyaro rwanyu n’urwacu ko natwe dufise uburenganzira bwo gusenga Uhoraho mu rusengero rwiwe, tugashikana amashikanwa yo guturirwa, ibimazi n’amashikanwa y’ishimwe. Ni ho uruvyaro rwanyu rutazobwira urwacu ruti: ‘Nta mugabane mufise k’ Uhoraho .’

Kandi twibwira tuti nibatubwira gutyo canke bakabibwira uruvyaro rwacu, tuzobabwira tuti: ‘Ehe raba igicaniro kimeze nk’ic’ Uhoraho ba sogokuruza bacu bubatse. Si ico guturirirako amashikanwa canke gushikanirako ibimazi; ni icabona hagati ya twebwe na mwebwe.’

Ntibikabe ko tugarariza Uhoraho mu kwiyubakira igicaniro co gushikanirako amashikanwa yo guturirwa, amashikanwa y’ifu hamwe n’amashikanwa y’ishimwe; atari ku gicaniro c’ Uhoraho Imana yacu kiri imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro ryayo.”

Finehasi umuherezi hamwe n’abarongozi b’umuryango wa Isirayeli ari bo barongoye imice igize imiryango yose bumvise ivyo abo mu muryango wa Reyubeni, n’abo mu muryango wa Gadi n’ab’igice c’uwa Manase bababwiye, baranezerwa cane.

Finehasi mwene Eliyazeri umuherezi abwira abo mu muryango wa Reyubeni, n’abo mu muryango wa Gadi n’ab’igice c’uwa Manase ati: “Uyu musi dutahuye ko Uhoraho ari kumwe natwe, kuko mutakoze ibikorwa vyo kugarariza Uhoraho nk’uko twavyibaza. Mukijije Isirayeli ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho .”
Maze Finehasi mwene Eliyazeri umuherezi hamwe n’abo barongozi baca basezera imiryango ya Reyubeni na Gadi, bava muri iyo ntara ya Gileyadi, basubira i Kanani, biganira abandi Bisirayeli ivyabaye.
Na bo bavyumvise barahimbarwa, bashima Imana. Ntibaba baciyumvira ivyo gutera imiryango ya Reyubeni na Gadi ngo bazimanganye igihugu babamwo.
Maze abo mu muryango wa Reyubeni n’uwa Gadi baca bita izina ico gicaniro rivuga riti: “Icabona hagati yacu ko Uhoraho ari we Mana.”

headings.text: Abo mu miryango yo mu buseruko batahuka

verses.text: Inyuma y’igihe kirekire Uhoraho ahaye amahoro Abisirayeli akabakiza abansi babo bose bari babakikuje, Yosuwa yari ageze mu zabukuru.
Nuko akoranya Abisirayeli bose; abatware bose, abarongozi n’abacamanza arababwira ati: “Ehe raba ndageze mu zabukuru.
Mwese mwarabonye ivyo Uhoraho yakoreye aya mahanga yose ku bwanyu; Uhoraho Imana yanyu ni yo yabagwaniye.
Mwibuke ingene nagaburiye imiryango yanyu intara mwahawe nk’imigabane, igihugu cose twafashe n’ico tutarafata, kuva kuri Yorodani gushika ku Kiyaga Mediterane mu burengero.
Iki gihugu kizoba icanyu, kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu we nyene azokwiyirukanira ayo mahanga abahunge. Azobirukana imbere yanyu namwe mufate igihugu cabo, nk’uko Uhoraho Imana yanyu yabibasezeraniye.
None rero mushire imitima yanyu ku vyanditswe muri iki gitabu c’ivyagezwe vya Mose, ntimuzohengamire i buryo canke i bubamfu.
Ntimuzokwifatanye n’ayandi mahanga akiri muri mwebwe, ntimuzokwambaze amazina y’imana zabo canke ngo murahire mu mazina yazo. Ntimuzozikorere canke ngo munazunamire.
Ariko mwumire k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu nk’uko mwayumiyeko gushika ubu.
Uhoraho yirukanye amahanga akomakomeye imbere yanyu, gushika ubu nta na rimwe rirabahagarara imbere.
Umwe muri mwebwe yirukana igihumbi, kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu ari we abagwanira nk’uko yabibasezeraniye.
None rero mushire imitima yanyu ku gukunda Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ariko nimwahindukira mukifatanya n’abacitse kw’icumu bo muri aya mahanga basigaye muri mwebwe canke mugahana abageni mukivanga na bo,

mumenye ko Uhoraho atazokwirukana ayo mahanga imbere yanyu. Ariko bazobabera imitego muzogwamwo, bababere inkoni zo kubakubita mu migongo n’amahwa abazibura mu maso, gushika mutikiriye muri iki gihugu ciza Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye.

Ehe ndi mu kwitaba Imana nk’uko bigendera abandi bose. Murazi n’imitima yanyu yose n’imishaha yanyu yose ko ata ciza na kimwe Uhoraho Imana yanyu yasezeranye kitashitse. Ivyo yasezeranye vyose yarabishikije, nta na kimwe cavuyemwo.
Ariko nk’uko iciza cose Uhoraho Imana yanyu yasezeranye cashitse, ni ko n’ibibi vyose Uhoraho yavuze bizoshika nimwamugarariza. Azobatikiza gushika muhonere muri iki gihugu ciza yabahaye.
Nimwaca kubiri n’isezerano Uhoraho Imana yanyu yabahaye, mukunamira izindi mana mukazisenga, uburake bw’ Uhoraho buzobaziriringira, muhonere bidatevye muri ico gihugu ciza yabahaye.”
Maze Yosuwa akoraniriza i Shekemu imiryango yose ya Isirayeli. Ahamagaza abakuru, abatware, abacamanza n’abarongozi, bose baza imbere y’Imana.

Yosuwa abarira abantu bose ati: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli avuze: ‘Mu gihe ca kera, ba sogokuruza banyu, harimwo Tera se wa Aburahamu na Nahori, babaye hakurya y’uruzi Efurate kandi basenga izindi mana.
Ariko mfata sogokuruza Aburahamu ndamukura hakurya y’urwo ruzi ndamushikana i Kanani, ndamuha uruvyaro runini nciye kuri Isaka.
Isaka namuhaye Yakobo na Esawu. Esawu namuhaye imisozi ya Seyiri ngo ayegukire, ariko Yakobo n’abana biwe ndabamanukana muri Egiputa.
Maze ntuma Mose na Aroni, nongera ntera ivyago Abanyegiputa, hanyuma ndabakura muri Egiputa.
Igihe nakura ba sogokuruza banyu muri Egiputa, mwashitse ku Kiyaga Gitukura, Abanyegiputa babakurikira bari ku mikogote no ku mafarasi.
Ariko ba sogokuruza banyu batakambira jewe Uhoraho ngo ndabatabare, nca nsuka umwijima hagati yabo n’Abanyegiputa, ndabarenzako ikiyaga kirabatwara. Amaso yanyu yariboneye ivyo nakoreye Egiputa.
Nabazanye mu gihugu c’Abamori baba mu buseruko bwa Yorodani. Barabagwanije, ariko ndabatanga mu maboko yanyu. Nabaranduye imbere yanyu, namwe mufata igihugu cabo.
Igihe Balaki mwene Zipori, umwami w’i Mowabu, yitegura ngo agwanye Abisirayeli, yarungitse Balamu mwene Beyori kubavuma.
Ariko sinumviriza Balamu, na we aho kubavuma arabahezagira, gutyo ndabakiza Balaki.

Nuko mujabuka Yorodani mushika i Yeriko, abatware b’i Yeriko barabatera ngo babagwanye, nk’uko Abamori, Abaperizi, Abanyakanani, Abaheti, Abagirugashi, Abahiwi n’Abayebusi babigize. Ariko nabatanze mu maboko yanyu.
Narungitse amavubi imbere yanyu, yirukana abami babiri b’Abamori. Si inkota yanyu canke umuheto wanyu vyabahaye intsinzi.
Nabahaye igihugu c’amatongo mutarimye, n’ibisagara mutubatse, mubibamwo, murya inzabibu n’imyelayo mutateye.’
None rero, nimwubahe Uhoraho mumukorere mu kuri no mu bwizigirwa; mushire kure imana ba sogokuruza banyu bakoreye hakurya y’uruzi Efurate, no muri Egiputa, hanyuma mukorere Uhoraho .

Ariko nimba mudashaka gukorera Uhoraho , nimwitorere uwu musi iyindi mana mukorera, zaba imana ba sogokuruza bakorera hakurya y’uruzi Efurate, zaba imana z’Abamori, abo mubereye mu gihugu. Ariko twe n’abo mu nzu yanje, tuzokorera Uhoraho .”
Maze abantu bose bishura bati: “Guheba Uhoraho tugakorera izindi mana ntibikatubeko!

Uhoraho Imana yacu ni we yatwikuriye muri Egiputa twe na ba sogokuru bacu, mu gihugu c’ubuja, akorera ibitangaza n’ibimenyetso mu maso yacu. Yaturinze urugendo rwose atuzigamira mu mahanga yose twaciyemwo.
Uhoraho ni we yirukanye ayo mahanga yose imbere yacu, harimwo Abamori baba muri iki gihugu. None rero natwe tuzokorera Uhoraho , kuko ni we Mana yacu wenyene.”
Maze Yosuwa arababarira ati: “Mwebwe ntimushoboye gukorera Uhoraho , kuko ni Imana itunganye kandi ipfuha. Ntizokwihanganira ubugarariji n’ivyaha vyanyu.
Nimwava k’ Uhoraho mugakorera izindi mana, azobateza ivyago bibatikize bibamare, inyuma y’ivyiza vyose yabagiriye.”
Na bo bishura Yosuwa bati: “Haba na mba! Tuzokorera Uhoraho .”
Maze Yosuwa arababarira ati: “Mwebwe ubwanyu muri ivyabona vyanyu ko mwahisemwo gukorera Uhoraho .” Na bo bati: “Egome turi ivyabona.”
Yosuwa arababwira ati: “Nuko rero nimukure imana z’abanyamahanga ziri muri mwebwe, imitima yanyu muyegurire Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli.”
Na bo bishura Yosuwa bati: “Tuzokorera Uhoraho Imana yacu, twongere tumwubahe.”
Uwo musi nyene Yosuwa aca agirana isezerano n’abo bantu aho i Shekemu, aca abaha amabwirizwa n’ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho .
Hanyuma Yosuwa aca yandika ivyo vyose mu gitabu c’ivyagezwe vy’Imana. Afata n’ibuye rinini ry’icibutso, arishira musi y’igiti kinini kiri hafi y’ihema ry’ibonaniro ry’ Uhoraho .
Yosuwa ababwira ati: “Iri buye ni icabona hagati yacu. Ryumvise ivyo Uhoraho yatubwiye vyose. Rizobacira urubanza nimwava ku Mana yanyu.”
Nuko Yosuwa aca arabarungika basubira iwabo, umwe wese aja mu ntara bahawe nk’iragi ryabo.
Inyuma y’ivyo vyose, Yosuwa mwene Nuni, umusavyi w’ Uhoraho , arahwera amaze imyaka ijana na cumi.
Bamuhamba mw’itongo yahawe i Timunati-Sera, mu ntara y’imisozi ya Efurayimu, haruguru y’umusozi Gayashi.
Abisirayeli bakorera Uhoraho mu gihe cose Yosuwa yari akiriho no mu gihe c’abatware bakoranye na we, abo yasize amaze gupfa, hamwe n’abandi bose bari barabonye ivyo Uhoraho yari yarakoreye Isirayeli.

Na ya magufa ya Yosefu Abisirayeli bari baduganye bayakuye muri Egiputa baca bayahamba i Shekemu, mw’itongo Yakobo yari yaraguze ibiceri vy’ifeza ijana ahaguze na bene Hamori se wa Shekemu. Ryaciye riba iry’uruvyaro rwa Yosefu.
Hanyuma Eliyazeri mwene Aroni arapfa, ahambwa i Gibeya, ahari hahawe umuhungu wiwe Finehasi mu gihugu c’imisozi miremire ca Efurayimu.
